1) State-action signatures: compress cumulative interaction histories into compact identifiers so states/actions become comparable across rollouts. Because signatures encode cumulative history, each signature appears at most once per rollout, satisfying the first-visit MC requirement.
2) Tree-based first-visit Monte Carlo: for each rollout and step t, compute discounted return G_t and update a statistics table indexed by (s,a) with visit counts N(s,a) and return sums. Estimate Q^(s,a) as the mean return over rollouts that first-visit (s,a). Derive a state baseline V^(s) by aggregating Q^ over actions available at s, and compute per-step advantage A^(s,a)=Q^(s,a)-V^(s).
3) Prior-based value smoothing: to handle sparsely visited nodes (high variance / unstable estimates), apply a prior-driven smoothing mechanism so advantages remain informative throughout the tree.
4) LLM-agent integration: actions are variable-length token spans (reasoning + tool call + arguments). Only action tokens receive policy-gradient updates; RTMC assigns one advantage per (s_t,a_t) and broadcasts it to all tokens in that action span.c6c:T64f,must_read (deep technical analysis + guide):
- Key sections:
  1) Section 3: understand tree construction, the (s,a) statistics table, first-visit MC estimation of Q^/V^/A^, why it is unbiased, how variance scales with N(s,a), and the exact prior-based smoothing rule.
  2) Section 4: the practical linchpin—how signatures (view bucketing, content hashing, action classification) define “state equivalence” and the bias/variance trade-off of abstraction.

1) Tail model: assume losses/rewards are sub-Weibull with parameter θ via the Orlicz norm \|X\|_{\psi_\theta}. Smaller θ means heavier tails; MGFs may be infinite for 0<θ<1.
2) Core ingredient: a tail-adaptive decorrelation (change-of-measure) lemma based on a shifted-log f_\theta-divergence, f_\theta(x)=x\,\log^{1/\theta}(x+A). This replaces KL/MGF-based arguments by directly controlling dependent-coupling expectations in a way that explicitly depends on θ.
3) Usable dependence measures: the paper upper-bounds this f_\theta-divergence in terms of Rényi divergence, yielding bounds in terms of Rényi mutual information. Intuitively, higher-order Rényi quantities penalize rare-but-extreme events more strongly than KL, which is crucial under heavy tails.

1) Setting: study multi-class linear in-context classification in the hard no-margin regime, aiming for an algebraically identifiable inference rule.
2) Identifiability obstacle: task symmetries (permuting examples, feature coordinates, or class labels) are not enforced layer by layer in standard training, so learned weights encode accidental asymmetries that obscure the underlying algorithm.
3) Layerwise symmetry enforcement (identifiability protocol): at each layer, conjugate the attention block by a random block permutation over feature and label coordinates (apply P, run attention, then apply P^T). This forces each layer to implement the same computation in every symmetric coordinate system, acting as a structural denoiser that collapses weights onto a low-dimensional interpretable manifold. Functional equivalence is checked via output alignment and query/context sensitivity fingerprints.
4) Closed-form layerwise recursion: with symmetry enforced, the forward pass becomes readable. Let X_ℓ be training-token features and Y_ℓ their label vectors at depth ℓ. Each iteration forms an affinity/attention matrix from a mixed feature–label Gram structure (feature similarity + label agreement), then uses the same weights to propagate updates to both X_ℓ and Y_ℓ. The query token is updated analogously by attending to the training set and accumulating class evidence across layers.
5) Mechanistic interpretation: the resulting computation is a coupled feature–label dynamical system (coupled mean-shift-like), where representation geometry and label geometry co-evolve. In a label-driven regime, the dynamics preserve class structure and monotonically amplify inter-class separation (margin amplification): a few labeled points anchor classes, and performance is driven by geometric separation.
6) Generalization across tasks: the recursion predicts success in semi-supervised ICL (unlabeled points sharpen geometry), label-noise regimes, and prototype/Voronoi settings when clusters are well separated. Retraining on these tasks recovers the same symmetry-aligned weight structure and the same coupled dynamical motif (with task-specific schedules).c77:T4b7,They propose CSAttention (Centroid-Scoring Attention), a training-free sparse attention method built around a storage-for-computation tradeoff.
- Offline prefill (one-time, amortized): split the feature space into m subspaces; cluster prefill queries in each subspace into C centroids. For each centroid, precompute partial dot-products with all keys in that subspace (centroid-scores) and store a compressed, bounded Top-L list (key indices + scores).
- Online decode (per step): for a new query, pick the nearest centroid in each subspace (1-of-C), fetch the m short lists, and accumulate partial scores by key index on GPU. Keys that align with the query tend to score well across multiple subspaces and rise to the top after accumulation; then select Top-k keys for sparse attention.
- Incremental maintenance: as new keys arrive during decoding, attempt to insert them into the relevant centroids’ Top-L lists only if their partial score exceeds the current minimum, keeping capacity bounded and update overhead small.
The key idea is query-centric indexing to mitigate Q/K distribution shift, plus regular, GPU-friendly data structures/kernels to avoid full-context scans and irregular control flow.c78:T63a,must_read (deep technical analysis + what to focus on)

For each input token x, each tree performs D hard binary routing decisions from root to leaf, evaluating exactly one node per level; thus each tree activates a single path and the layer activates exactly P×D nodes. Each node has (1) routing parameters (w_in, b_in) producing a scalar logit used for a hard left/right decision, with stop-gradient used around the discrete decision; and (2) output parameters (w_out) producing a contribution vector. The layer output is the sum of the output vectors from all visited nodes along the path (internal nodes both route and contribute). Compared to MoE, there is no separate router network, no top-k expert aggregation, and sparsity is hierarchical/structured.
A key finding is an emergent auto-pruning effect: the interaction of hard routing and asymmetric nonlinearities progressively deactivates entire branches during training, partially converting input-dependent dynamic sparsity into stable structural sparsity. The paper argues this behavior is controllable via simple architectural choices, helping manage routing imbalance and tree utilization without auxiliary balancing losses.c7a:T4b0,must_read (deep read)

1) Geometric framing: Pretraining minimizes a weighted average of K source losses. The paper distinguishes two solution types that achieve the same L_train: Sum-type (only optimal for the aggregate) vs Intersection-type (geometrically close to each source optimum). The key quantity is “closeness,” treated as a second-order property tied to curvature/Hessian structure.
2) Theoretical motivation (quadratic/i.i.d.): Under simplified quadratic losses with i.i.d. task distribution, the paper states a result (Theorem 2.2) that, at the same pretraining loss, Intersection-type minimizers strictly outperform Sum-type minimizers on a downstream task drawn from the same distribution.
3) Tractable proxy: Directly optimizing closeness is intractable because it would require knowing each source’s exact minimizer during training. The authors argue/prove that gradient cosine similarity CosSim(∇L_i, ∇L_j) upper-bounds closeness: if gradient directions across sources are always aligned, their minimizers must coincide (or be very close).
4) Nexus algorithm: Without changing the pretraining objective, Nexus introduces an optimizer-level mechanism to maximize cross-source gradient cosine similarity. It approximates and uses ∇CosSim(∇L_i, ∇L_j) (involving second-order information / gradients of gradients) and combines it with standard pretraining optimizers (e.g., Adam/Muon) to bias updates toward more aligned gradients, thereby steering convergence toward Intersection-type common minima.
5) Mechanistic link to downstream: In Sec. 5.1, the authors claim that increased gradient similarity and geometric closeness not only hold among training sources but also transfer to downstream tasks, yielding lower downstream loss and better metrics at identical pretraining loss.c7d:T559,(must_read: deep reading)

1) Key observation (linear-layer gradients lie in activation span): for a linear layer, the weight gradient is G_W = X^T G_out, hence it lies in the span/column space of input activations X. Therefore, if activations are approximated in a rank-r subspace, gradients admit an optimal rank-r representation in the same subspace.
2) Compress activations while keeping forward exact: OASIS does not modify forward-pass computation. It only projects and stores intermediate activations for backward:
- Store \tilde X_t = X_t U_t (N×r) instead of X_t (N×d).
- Perform gradient/optimizer computations in the low-rank space and project updates back via U_t.
3) Joint low-rank gradients and optimizer states: since gradients are kept as (r×m), Adam’s first/second moments can be stored and updated in the same low-rank space, reducing memory from O(dm) to O(rm) per layer.
4) Online subspace learning (core novelty): U_t cannot be fixed because activation distributions drift as parameters change. The paper uses Oja’s rule (streaming PCA) to update U_t incrementally without repeated exact eigendecomposition.
5) Projection-aware state updates: when U_t changes, low-rank momentum/variance states must be transformed to remain consistent with the new basis; otherwise optimization becomes unstable. Following LDAdam, they apply projection-aware alignment of optimizer states after subspace updates.
6) Cost/benefit: per layer, activation storage drops Nd→Nr; gradients and optimizer states drop dm→rm. Extra overhead comes from maintaining U_t and projections, aiming for large peak-memory savings with acceptable throughput/accuracy.c7f:T4e9,(must_read: deep reading)

3) 注意力与推理效率：采用混合注意力机制并引入 GQA（Grouped Query Attention）。不同于常见“仅在自回归解码器用 GQA 以减少 KV cache”的用法，作者强调在视觉编码器中也使用 GQA：即使没有 KV cache，GQA 仍可通过降低注意力复杂度与提升硬件利用率带来端到端效率收益，且推理框架支持成熟。
4) 解码吞吐：语言侧引入 Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) 模块（来自 K-EXAONE），以提升解码吞吐（更快生成）。
5) 位置编码：视觉编码器使用 2D RoPE 以建模二维空间结构；语言模型保留 1D RoPE 以兼容既有文本预训练位置表征，避免破坏语言能力。
6) 分辨率策略：训练时校准最大图像分辨率，避免为了“理论覆盖”支持超高分辨率而导致训练显著变慢；以真实常见输入为上限，强调资源利用与实用性。
7) 分词与多语：复用 K-EXAONE tokenizer（相对 EXAONE 4.0 在多语、尤其韩语上增强），确保多语文本表示与系列模型一致性。
8) 预训练流程（两阶段课程）：
  - Stage 0/前置：先用受 OpenVision2 启发的自回归目标从零训练 1.2B 视觉编码器，使其与目标架构/训练范式对齐。
  - Stage 1-2 多模态预训练：端到端联合训练，数据混合包含：通用图文对、交错图文文档、文档理解、OCR 样本；同时混入大量 text-only（来自 K-EXAONE 的 pre/post-training 数据）以防语言能力退化。
  - 课程调整：逐步降低“通用域图文对”占比，提高 grounding/文档/OCR 等高密度结构化信息占比，并加入知识/数学/STEM 数据，为后续复杂多模态任务打底。
9) 数据构建与合成描述：语料以韩英双语对为主；针对网页 caption 短且噪声大，使用合成 caption 管线增强语义密度与对齐质量；并专门引入数学、图表、示意图、文档解析等任务导向图像以缩小与下游基准的差距；为降低幻觉，合成描述参考既有元数据，强调细粒度、可证据支撑的描述。c82:T942,(must_read: detailed technical analysis)
1) Architecture integration: attach a newly trained 1.2B-parameter vision encoder to the EXAONE 4.0 32B language backbone via a vision-language merger; train vision encoder + merger + LLM end-to-end.
2) Visual token vs. quality trade-off: the report argues against naive token reduction due to loss of critical spatial/semantic information; instead it uses a billion-scale vision encoder to retain richer representations and avoid aggressive truncation.
3) Attention and efficiency: adopt hybrid attention mechanisms and Grouped Query Attention (GQA). Beyond the common use of GQA in autoregressive decoders for KV-cache savings, they also apply GQA inside the vision encoder; even without KV caching, GQA reduces attention complexity and improves hardware utilization, and is well supported by inference frameworks.
4) Decoding throughput: incorporate Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) from K-EXAONE to speed up generation.
5) Positional encoding: use 2D RoPE in the vision encoder to model 2D spatial structure; keep standard 1D RoPE in the language model to remain compatible with pretrained textual positional representations.
6) Resolution policy: cap maximum training resolution to match common real-world inputs, avoiding the heavy cost of ultra-high-resolution support.
7) Tokenizer/multilinguality: reuse the K-EXAONE tokenizer with improved multilingual (notably Korean) handling.
8) Pretraining pipeline (two-stage curriculum):
  - First, train the 1.2B vision encoder from scratch with an autoregressive objective inspired by OpenVision2.
  - Then run two-stage multimodal pretraining with a mixture of general image-text pairs, interleaved image-text documents, document understanding data, and OCR-centric samples; mix in substantial text-only data (from K-EXAONE pre/post-training) to prevent language capability degradation.
  - Curriculum shifts away from generic samples toward grounding/document/OCR and adds knowledge/math/STEM data to prepare for complex multimodal tasks.
9) Synthetic captioning: since web captions are short/noisy, a synthetic caption pipeline increases semantic richness and alignment; task-oriented images (math, charts, diagrams, document parsing) are added to bridge to downstream benchmarks; metadata is used as evidence to reduce hallucinations and keep descriptions specific and factual.c83:T456,must_read (deep reading)

- Pretraining pipeline: study the two-stage curriculum, the data mixture shift toward document/OCR/structured content, and how text-only mixing prevents language degradation.

Key components: (1) Upstream: generate an early-stopped reasoning segment s; compute its MC reward by sampling downstream continuations and aggregating their outcome rewards; optimize upstream with single-stream optimization to reduce instability (lower per-prompt sample needs and more stable baselines from historical samples). (2) Downstream: keep GRPO-style group-relative optimization at the outcome level, but add a skip connection by feeding [s, q] (upstream segment concatenated with the original question), allowing the model to leverage helpful upstream reasoning while preserving exploration freedom. (3) Engineering: a single-pass rollout reuses samples to achieve compute parity with GRPO. The method also yields an “implicit advantage”: even when final correctness is matched, SKPO-trained trajectories exhibit higher intermediate-step quality, emerging from the optimization structure rather than extra supervision.c87:T80d,must_read（精读建议：详细技术分析 + reading_guide）

SPPO makes this explicit:
1) Reformulation (MDP→SL-CB): prompt is the context; the entire CoT/response is a single action; horizon collapses to H=1, removing long-horizon GAE bias and tail-overfitting issues.
2) Sequence-level PPO objective: compute a sequence-level probability ratio (sum of token logprobs) and apply PPO’s clipped surrogate at the sequence level.
3) Learned scalar value baseline: train a scalar V(context) to predict expected terminal reward for the prompt, using advantage = R_terminal − V(context). This reduces variance without GRPO’s multi-sample group baseline.
4) Efficiency via N=1 updates: with a learned baseline, SPPO supports single-sample updates per prompt, boosting training throughput.
5) Decoupled Critic: use a smaller critic (e.g., 1.5B) to provide the scalar baseline for a larger policy (e.g., 7B), enabled by the reduced complexity of sequence-level value estimation, yielding notable memory savings (reported ~12.8%).c89:T547,must_read (deep technical + guide)

- Jump to main result tables and speed/memory comparisons (incl. Fig.6) to confirm the headline claims.c8a:T530,The work studies replay buffers in realistic asynchronous LLM RL pipelines.

1) Asynchronous setup: GPUs are split into inference workers (generate rollouts) and trainers (backprop updates). Workers and trainers may hold slightly different (stale) weights, so some off-policiness exists inherently.
2) Replay buffer mechanism: workers write rollouts into a buffer (often FIFO keeping the last N samples). Trainers sample batches from the buffer; sampling does not remove items, enabling multiple reuses (replay ratio > 1). Sampling can be uniform or based on recency, reward, gradient norms, or reuse count; eviction/decay rules can be applied.
3) Theory (core): formalizes compute-optimal design via a bias–variance view of SGD that trades off:
- staleness-induced bias/variance (more replay → more off-policy),
- reduced sample diversity (too small/overused buffer),
- high rollout generation cost.
Derives qualitative/quantitative guidance for optimal buffer size and replay ratio: as inference cost increases relative to training, the compute-optimal strategy shifts toward more replay.
4) Empirical design space: systematically varies buffer hyperparameters and worker/trainer ratios (W/T), and explores smarter sampling (e.g., prioritizing positive trajectories) and alternative losses to extend stable replay regimes.c8b:T581,must_read (deep technical + guide)

  3) Theory: bias–variance framing that unifies staleness, diversity, and generation cost; pay attention to how optimal buffer/replay scales with inference cost.
  4) Ablations: extract practical defaults from sweeps over buffer size, replay ratio, W/T, and sampling strategies; note boundaries where replay becomes harmful.

  - Fig.1: headline compute savings vs final performance.

Training updates only {A,B,β} while keeping W_seed fixed. The intuition is reservoir-like: a stable random backbone provides rich random features/dynamics, and the low-rank adapters act as a low-dimensional controller that steers computation layer-by-layer. Mechanistically, they report that when the scaffold is static, optimization keeps using it (learned β stays strictly positive, with architecture-dependent magnitude); if the scaffold is resampled during training (destroying stability), β is driven toward 0 and the adapters must carry essentially all task information. Thus, the exact random values are interchangeable, but being fixed is essential—linking the method to Reservoir Computing, with depth playing the role of “time” in feedforward nets and LoRA acting beyond a single linear readout.c8e:T79a,must_read (deep technical analysis + what to focus on)

Existing MTP methods provide denser supervision and can support speculative decoding, but they are usually auxiliary by design: future-token losses are handled by horizon-specific heads attached to the backbone. This creates two issues. First, multi-horizon supervision reaches the backbone only indirectly, so the parameters responsible for next-token generation may not actually learn to plan further ahead. Second, deeper horizons are expensive: every extra prediction step adds modules and compute, which is why large-scale causal MTP often stops at a single draft token. ECHO asks whether future-token prediction can be turned from an auxiliary branch into a self-recursive use of the backbone itself, so that long-horizon supervision directly shapes the model and remains affordable.","importance":"For pretraining, the contribution is meaningful because it reframes MTP from an inference-oriented add-on into a training objective that can alter the backbone more directly. If the same parameters used for next-token generation are also trained to predict multiple future steps, then multi-horizon supervision is no longer mostly absorbed by side modules. That matters for representation learning, especially for reasoning and code, where longer-horizon structure is more important. A second contribution is practical: ECHO makes deeper causal supervision nearly parameter-free and keeps the average training overhead low through dynamic depth sampling. A third contribution is at the pretrain–inference interface. Since drafting is learned through recursive reuse of pretrained weights, the method removes the need for post-hoc drafter finetuning and supports depth extrapolation at inference. That is a cleaner recipe than maintaining a separate drafter pipeline after μ(g)=E[clip_c(g+ξ)] 的分解。作者证明它可以写成沿真梯度 g 的正向缩放项，加上一个改变方向的残差项 r(g)。由于 LMO 对正比例缩放不敏感，即 LMO(λg)=LMO(g), λ>0，所以 clipping 带来的主导影响在经过 LMO 后会被“看不见”；真正进入优化误差的是方向残差，而这个残差由 centered gradient variance differential privacy, where gradients are clipped per example and corrupted by Gaussian noise before the optimizer ever sees them? The challenge is not privacy accounting but optimization. In DP training, clipping introduces a state-dependent bias, privacy noise is injected at every step, momentum accumulates these perturbations along a changing trajectory, and Muon then applies a nonlinear orthogonalization map. Much of the prior theory for private nonconvex optimization avoids this regime by assuming uniformly bounded per-example gradients, so clipping is effectively inactive. This work instead analyzes the realistic active-clipping regime and studies whether Muon, and more generally momentum-LMO methods, still have meaningful guarantees there.","importance":"Its direct relevance to large-scale pretraining is moderate, but it is useful for optimizer research around foundation models. The more important result is structural: clipping mainly acts like a positive rescaling of the gradient, and LMO-based updates are invariant to that rescaling; what matters is the residual that changes direction. That places Muon, Scion, normalized SGD, and sign-based methods into a common framework and clarifies their robustness under clipping and noise. Third, the empirical findings are operationally relevant: under DP, the optimal batch size can shift upward by one to two orders of magnitude, and optimizer ranking becomes batch-size dependent. That is a useful warning for anyone trying to transfer non-private training recipes into private or data-constrained 什么时候该提前停止、什么时候该放弃继续推理。现有方法通常监控置信度、熵或答案稳定性，然后设一个阈值；问题在于阈值高度依赖模型、数据集、prompt 形式和最大推理长度，换一个 deployment cell 往往就失效。作者把问题从“找一个可迁移阈值”改写成“沿着推理轨迹做序贯证据累积”，希望得到对任意停止时刻都成立的错误控制。","importance":"它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning model 的推理时 compute allocation 很有启发，尤其是当大家越来越重视 test-time scaling、adaptive inference 和 token efficiency 时。更重要的是，这篇工作提出的不是又一个经验性 stopping heuristic，而是一套带 anytime-valid 保证的统计框架。对基座研究员而言，价值在于两点：第一，它说明很多 inference-time policy 问题可以从 sequential testing 而不是 validation calibration 来做；第二，它把“跨模型/跨数据集可迁移的控制参数”从经验阈值换成显著性水平 α，这种接口更稳，也更适合真实部署场景。","technical_approach":"方法叫 CES，Calibration-Free Early Stopping。核心思想是把 CoT 生成看成一个随时间展开的序列，每个 chunk t 都会产生一个当前预测 f_t(x) 和一个标量信号 s_t，例如答案置信度、最近若干步的一致性、熵下降等。作者不去设计新的 primary signal，而是假设你已经有一个可用信号，研究如何基于它做 stopping。\n\n关键工具是 e-process。可以把它理解成一种序贯证据累积量：如果某个“无效进展”或“无充分证据”的原假设成立，那么这个过程在任意停止时刻都不会太大；一旦它变得足够大，就说明沿轨迹积累到了足够反对原假设的证据。作者利用 Ville’s inequality 给出 anytime-valid 的 false alarm 控制，因此不需要 held-out calibration。\n\n具体实现上，CES 在同一个信号 s_t 上跑两个 e-process：\n1. commit stream：看当前信号相对其慢趋势的位置，判断是否已经有足够证据提交当前答案；\n2. abstain stream：看信号的 signed velocity，判断推理是否在走弱、停滞或朝不利方向发展，从而提前放弃并交给 fallback。\n\n这两个流被设计成天然反相关。直观上，如果 s_t 持续上升，commit 证据会累积，而 abstain 证据会被削弱；如果 s_t 开始下滑或停滞，abstain 更容易触发。这样做的好处是，系统不必把“某个绝对信号值”硬映射成正确率，而是根据轨迹中的相对变化和趋势来做对称决策。\n\n从方法取舍看，这篇工作的重点不是证明某个特定信号最好，而是把 stopping policy 从“静态阈值比较”改成“动态证据检验”。这使它更像一个上层决策框架，可以套在已有 confidence/stability signal 上。局限也很明确：理论保证是 signal-level 的，不是 task-level correctness guarantee。也就是说，若底层信号本身和最终正确性关联很弱，CES 也不会凭空变好；它只是比阈值法更稳地消费这个信号。","experiments":"实验主结论是：在多个 model–dataset 组合上，CES 用零校准数据就能达到或超过 Conformal Thinking 的 token–accuracy Pareto，并且在跨 cell 迁移时更稳。这里的“cell”指模型、数据集、prompt 或预算组合。CT 这类方法需要在每个 cell 上做阈值校准，严格风险目标下如果验证集不够大，校准本身就会变得困难；即便能校准，换环境后保证也不再成立。CES 则直接用统一的显著性参数 α 控制停止规则。\n\n从正文描述看，作者评估时把 probing 成本也算进 token 开销，而不是只看最终生成长度，这一点是合理的，因为很多 early-exit 方法会忽略监控代价。实验比较的重点不是单纯准确率，而是 token 使用和准确率之间的折中曲线。\n\n更值得注意的是方法验证逻辑：\n1. 在同一信号输入下，CES 相比阈值/校准式规则更稳；\n2. 在不同模型、数据集和推理长度设置下，α 的语义保持一致，而经验阈值不具备这种可迁移性；\n3. 双 e-process 的 commit/abstain 设计减少了两种错误：过早提交错误答案，以及在明显无望的样本上继续浪费 token。\n\n摘要没有给出具体数字，正文节选里也没有完整表格，因此无法准确复述提升幅度。但从实验设计看，作者真正想证明的是“无需 per-cell calibration 仍能维持有竞争力的 token–accuracy tradeoff”，而不是追求某个 benchmark 上的绝对最优。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先看问题设定和理论接口，再看实验，不必一开始陷入 e-process 细节推导。预计 25 分钟左右能抓住主要贡献；如果要复现或改造到自己的推理系统，再回头精读公式。\n\n优先看 Introduction 中对现有 early verifier-based inference and test-time compute. The main contribution is to turn a model’s global correctness judgment into an energy function over discrete assignments. That matters because it separates answer generation from answer evaluation: a model may fail when queried field by field, yet still recognize a correct full solution when shown one. For foundation-model training, the implication is that better global calibration and consistency judgments can be exploited at inference time through search. The paper also uses exhaustive scoring on small tasks to separate two failure modes: bad model scores versus inadequate search.","technical_approach":"For a task with several blanks, an assignment is a point in the Cartesian product of the candidate sets. The assignment is filled into the original task, followed by a fixed verification question asking whether the completed fill is correct for every blank. A trained decision model returns the Yes probability directly. For general-purpose Qwen models, the prompt ends at Answer:, and the method reads the next-token logits for Yes and No, applying a softmax over only those two tokens. The score becomes an energy E(x) = -log P(Yes). Search then modifies assignments to minimize this energy, either by local edits or by joint changes to several fields. The model is frozen, produces no solution text, and can be treated as an API scorer.","experiments":"On 128 synthetic logic puzzles, search raises Qwen3.8-27B from 27.8% to 48.5% per-blank accuracy, and from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Cloudflare Clef, and JEV all improve when their own Yes/No judgments are used as scores. Per-blank accuracy gains range from 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and exact-correct counts increase from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively, with the last value averaged over three search seeds. 上限时，额外预算到底该花在继续生成更多候选解，还是花在比较和裁决已经生成出的候选解上。过去很多方法要么只管多采样，要么在固定采样后再做 rerank/selection，但没有把“生成”和“裁决”放进同一个实时预算账本里统一决策。BOSS 研究的是 within-instance allocation，也就是对同一道题，预算如何在线分配给 generate / adjudicate / stop 三种动作。","importance":"它不是预训练论文，但对基座模型研究有两层启发。第一，很多关于推理能力的结论其实混杂了预算分配策略；如果不把 prompt token、completion token、judge token 一起计入，所谓 test-time scaling 的收益很容易被高估。第二，这篇工作把“答案选择”从后处理变成了与采样竞争预算的在线动作，这对今后研究 reasoning inference policy、verifier/judge 训练、以及 post-train 阶段如何塑造可比较的候选分布都有参考价值。对做基础模型的人来说，它提醒了一点：模型能力不只体现在单条轨迹质量，也体现在候选多样性和可裁决性上。","technical_approach":"BOSS 是一个 training-free 在线策略。核心不是新的 judge 模型，也不是新的采样器，而是一个预算忠实的决策框架。作者先形式化问题：每次模型调用都要计算 prompt+completion 的真实 token 消耗；生成调用有自己的最大新 token 上限 L_gen，裁决调用有 L_judge；在每次调用前，用 worst-case cost 检查剩余预算是否足够，保证任何自适应决策都不会超出单样本硬预算 B。这个约束很重要，因为很多已有方法默认 selection 是额外开销，或者只比较 completion token，不把 judge prompt 中重复包含的题目和候选答案算进去。\n\n在策略层面，BOSS 每轮生成一个 candidate 后做三选一：直接返回、继续生成、进入 adjudication。触发逻辑由三部分组成。第一是 consensus-based termination：如果当前候选答案已经形成足够稳定的一致性，就提前停止。第二是 novelty-based switch：如果新生成的候选不再带来有用的新答案模式，说明继续采样的边际收益下降，可以把剩余预算转去做比较。第三是 budget-feasible pairwise judging：在剩余预算允许的前提下，对候选代表进行成对比较，把裁决也纳入同一 token ledger。\n\n从论文描述看，BOSS 不是对所有候选做昂贵的全排序，而是基于答案分组、代表选择、重复随机裁决等较轻量机制来近似最优选择。作者还专门做了 identical candidate pool 对照：固定第一阶段生成出的候选池不变，只替换 selector，来证明收益来自 With multinomial resampling, high-weight particles are duplicated and low-weight ones are dropped. But in reasoning tasks, a lineage with low intermediate weight may still later reach the correct answer. A block starts as all MASK tokens, and each iteration runs the model once to obtain distributions for unresolved positions. During the first K iterations, BPD performs confidence-based prefilling: high-confidence predictions are committed in parallel and can split the remaining masks into shorter contiguous intervals. After that, each active interval selects a pivot near its center, subject to a confidence threshold. The selected pivots are committed simultaneously, and each interval is split into left and right children. The theory shows that if every pivot leaves no child longer than a fixed fraction rho of the parent interval, with rho between 1/2 and 1, the sequential depth for an interval of length J is O(log(J+1)). Exact midpoint selection gives ceil(log2(J+1)) rounds. Compaction","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"hf_upvotes":0,"cover_url":"/covers/2610_25933.png","published_at":"","arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.AI"],"recommendation":{"zh":"读方法推导和消融即可；softmax baselines."},"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是离线 KV-cache 压缩里最关键、也最容易被简化错的问题：删掉哪些 cache entry，不能只看单个 token 被删后的局部误差，因为注意力的 softmax 归一化会让所有保留下来的项一起变化。已有方法大多把“删除一个条目”的影响当成独立事件来打分，或者先选子集、再做 refit。这样会漏掉两个重要因素：一是删除决策之间存在耦合，二是剩余 value 可以通过补偿更新来吸收一部分误差。论文要解决的，就是如何在可承受的离线成本下，把“删除 + 补偿”联合起来做，而不是分成两个割裂步骤。","importance":"对基座研究本身，它不直接改变预训练范式，但对长上下文推理、固定知识库复用、企业文档/代码库问答这类高频场景很有现实意义。更具体地说，它把 offline KV compaction 从“启发式删点”推进到“近似联合优化”，这类思路对 memory-compute tradeoff、attention 近似、甚至训练期的 token pruning 也有参考价值。贡献量级属于推理效率方向里比较扎实的一类：不是换 benchmark 的小修补，而是明确指出 prior methods 的目标错位，并给出一个有闭式解、能落地、还能稳定改进 Pareto frontier 的替代方案。","technical_approach":"方法核心是构造一个 attention-output error 的二次 surrogate，然后用它做类似 Optimal Brain Surgeon 的逐步删除。论文先从单头 attention 的输出误差出发，不直接优化精确误差，因为精确目标受 softmax 归一化影响，删除一个 key/value 会联动改变所有剩余项的权重，组合优化代价太高。作者用 calibration queries 近似真实使用时的 query 分布，在这些 query 上展开误差，并推导出一个二次型 surrogate。这个 surrogate 有两个关键性质：\n1. 对每个候选删除项，都能写出“在删除该项后，剩余 cache 应该如何做最优补偿更新”的闭式表达；\n2. 也能写出“做完最优补偿后，surrogate loss 增加多少”的闭式分数。\n\n于是算法流程不是传统的“给每个 entry 打一个静态分数”，而是迭代式 greedy elimination：每一步都在当前已补偿过的 cache 上，评估删掉某个 entry 后的最优补偿残差，选损失最小的那个删掉，再把对应补偿真正应用到剩余 entries。这样下一步的选择是在新的、已经被修复过的表示上进行。这个设计和 OBCache、CAOTE 这类单删点评分方法的区别，在于它把 compensation 放进 selection 过程，而不是放到 selection 之后。\n\n论文还给出 KV-Surgeon-fast 这样的加速版本，用更低的离线代价逼近完整方法。完整 pipeline 还包括最后的 joint refit，用于在选定保留集后进一步拟合 compacted cache。作者强调，refit 不是新东西，关键在于前面的选择阶段已经显式考虑了 refit/compensation 能力，因此 retained set 本身更合理。\n\n从机制上看，这篇工作的一个好点在于它不只关注 key 侧的 attention mass，也显式考虑 value redundancy。若某个 value 已经接近当前输出，即便它 attention weight 不低，删掉它的真实输出误差也可能有限。把 value 几何结构纳入 surrogate，是它优于纯 attention matching 类方法的重要原因。","experiments":"实验覆盖 QuALITY、LongHealth、Long Code Arena，模型既有 dense 也有 MoE，规模从 4B 到 30B，压缩比从 5x 到 100x，范围算比较完整。主结论很清楚：在几乎所有设置下，KV-Surgeon 都把 cost-accuracy frontier 往外推，尤其在高压缩比时更明显。\n\n文中给出的代表性数字包括：\n- 在全部实验平均上，100x 压缩时，问答准确率比已有最好方法高 4.3 个百分点；\n- 50x 压缩时，平均高 3.0 个百分点；\n- 在 50x、最大模型的示例里，已有最强基线 The system captures a maximum-grid CUDA Graph once. Before each replay, the runtime updates seven active int32 fields with a 28-byte asynchronous copy. Plan-aware Triton kernels read the active extent from device memory and guard tiles that fall outside it. Active tiles execute the original payload; inactive tiles only pay the cost of a metadata load and comparison. Compared with AllShapes, this avoids enumerating all B,d shapes. Compared with OnDemand capture, it avoids first-use latency spikes. Compared with MaxPad, it keeps the maximum graph but prevents padded token positions from running projections, normalization, and feed-forward work. 在每一层完整跑完，再做选择，因此构建峰值显存仍然很高；像 KeyDiff 这类在线驱逐方法，虽然更早释放显存，但会在该层尚未看完整个 prompt 时就删 token，导致选择依据带有明显短视性。TideKV 想解决的就是这个 visibility-residency trade-off：既保留“看完整个 prompt 再决定保留谁”的全局可见性，又把 prefill 期间未压缩 KV importance 指标，而是把“何时构建、何时压缩、何时释放”重新排布，使已有 selector 可以在更低峰值内工作。这类工作对预训练研究也有间接价值，因为它提醒人们：上下文扩展不只是位置编码和训练 recipe 问题，推理期 cache 构建机制同样决定长上下文能力能否真正落地。若未来做原生长上下文预训练，这种 layer-major / chunked prefill 被切成多个 chunk，系统让这一层依次处理所有 chunk，并把该层的未压缩 KV 历史持续累积；只有当该层已经看完完整 prompt 后，才在层末执行 KV 选择与压缩，然后释放该层完整 KV，再进入下一层。这样每一层做选择时仍然拥有 full-prompt-aware 的因果历史，不会像在线驱逐那样在后文到来前过早删除。\n\n为了让压缩步骤本身不重新制造大显存峰值，作者设计了 prompt 长度解耦。论文把 selector 与调度解耦，意味着 SnapKV 一类 prefix-based 重要性规则可以直接嵌入 TideKV 的层末选择框架中。文中还支持 layer-adaptive 和 head-adaptive budget allocation，即不同层、不同头可分配不同 KV 预算，在不破坏 delayed-eviction 不变量的前提下做更细粒度的质量-显存折中。\n\n从方法性质看，这不是新的压缩准则，而是新的 cache construction architecture。它回答的是“如何在 GPU 上把压缩 cache 构建出来”，而不是“什么 token 最重要”。这点和很多只比较压缩率的 KV 论文不同。","experiments":"从引言可确认，实验覆盖 Llama 与 Mistral Existing methods split into two camps. Post-prefill compression methods, such as SnapKV-style selectors, preserve full-prompt visibility but still require each layer to process the entire prompt before compression, so the construction peak remains high. Online eviction methods reduce memory earlier, but they evict tokens before the layer has seen the full prompt, which makes selection myopic. 那样灵活继续往后扩展。因此，已有 block drafter 一方面浪费 verifier 计算，另一方面在整块被接受时又没有额外 draft 可用，限制了 acceptance length 和端到端速度。","importance":"它对基座研究的相关性主要在推理效率，而不是预训练本身。即便如此，这篇工作仍有启发，因为它抓住了一个很典型的问题：训练时固定 block size 的建模假设，会在推理时带来可用性边界。ReAnchor 的价值在于，它没有重训 drafter，也没有改 target model，而是把验证过程中“无效但有信息”的中间状态重新利用起来，说明 block diffusion drafting 还有不少系统层面的冗余可挖。对做 unified LM / diffusion LM 的人来说，这也是一个提醒：非 AR states，一次性预测固定长度的 draft block。问题在于，如果验证时在块内较早位置发生 rejection，那么后面那些位置的 verifier hidden states 虽然依赖了被拒绝 token，不能当作合法的 target cache 继续生成，但它们仍然包含局部上下文信息。\n\nReAnchor 的观察是：这些被丢弃的 verifier hidden states 仍可作为 pretrained drafter 的条件输入，用来在更靠后的位置重新启动同一个 drafter。具体做法是，在 baseline draft 之外，利用 post-rejection suffix 上若干 shifted positions 的 verifier hidden states 作为新 anchor，平行地产生多个同样长度的 draft blocks。然后通过一个匹配与拼接过程，把这些 reanchored blocks 的起始 token 与 baseline block 对齐；一旦起始部分匹配，就把它们的后续 token 接到相应位置上。这样做带来两类收益：一是在原始 block 内部提供附近位置的替代预测，相当于局部 refinement；二是在原始 block 末端之后继续延伸 draft coverage，相当于 block extension。\n\n关键点在于它保持 lossless decoding。所有附加 continuation 最终都要在新的 prefix 下由 target model 重新验证，因此不会改变目标分布。另一个优点是 training-free：不需要重训 DFlash，也不需要为 Domino、DSpark、Draft-OPD 这些变体分别设计新算法，只要它们沿用类似的 block diffusion drafting 接口，就能直接套用。","experiments":"实验结果比较完整，也给了明确数字。在 DFlash drafters 上，ReAnchor 在 4 个 target models、8 个 benchmarks、T=0 设置下，平均 acceptance length 提升 15.2%，平均 decoding speed 提升 13.4%。在 compression methods usually decide which tokens to keep, but they still assign the same cache budget to every decoder layer. The authors argue this is a poor assumption because layers are not equally dependent on past tokens. Uniform budgeting wastes memory on layers that do not need it and starves the layers that do. The goal is not to invent another token-importance score, but to learn a layer-wise cache allocation on top of existing eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV, and L2Norm, and to make that allocation transferable across deployment budgets rather than re-searching for every budget.","importance":"Its value is mainly on the inference/serving side, but it carries a useful structural lesson for foundation-model work. First, long-context performance is constrained not only by token selection rules, but also by how memory is distributed across layers. That degree of freedom has been largely ignored. Second, the paper turns layer-wise cache allocation into an offline calibration problem, similar in spirit to post-training quantization: search once offline, deploy with zero runtime overhead. Third, the learned allocations consistently favor a subset of middle layers, which is informative for understanding layer specialization in transformers and may motivate training-time designs with explicit memory heterogeneity. 准确率做代理指标，但正确答案可能来自模型参数记忆、任务捷径，或者压缩后恰好保留了一条可行推理链，却丢掉了其他同样必要的证据。KEEP-Bench把评测对象从“读者最终答得对不对”改成“压缩文本本身是否保留了全部关键证据”，试图直接测 faithfulness，而不是测 reader 选择——最终都在制造信息瓶颈。如果评测只看最终任务分数，就会高估压缩器的可靠性。KEEP-Bench的贡献主要是评测范式而不是新模型，但它提供了一个更贴近训练目标设计的问题定义：压缩器需要学会识别证据结构，而不只是保留高频表面线索。","technical_approach":"方法上有三个关键设计。第一，它构造了三类容易诱发“看似压缩成功、实际证据缺失”的诊断场景。parallel evidence 要求同时保留两个可能指代对象对应的并行证据链；conditional evidence 要求保留结论及其限定条件，防止压缩后把带条件陈述改写成无条件事实；imbalanced evidence 则要求在多数证据之外保留少数观点，测试压缩器是否会被证据量主导而忽略 minority perspective。第二，它把每个查询所需证据从原文中抽取出来，并分解成最小、自包含的 propositions。评测时不是看语义大意是否接近，而是逐条判断 proposition 是否被压缩文本明确陈述或可无歧义推出。第三，它提出 All Proposition Recall（All-Rec）：只有当一个样本所需的全部 propositions 都被保留时才记为成功。这比平均 proposition recall 更严格，因为真实推理常常被最短板决定。另一个指标 EPR 用 Claude-Haiku-4.5 在 parallel setting 明显领先，All-Rec 约为 GPT-5.4-mini 的两倍，但在 imbalanced science cases 上反而落后，说明单一类型 benchmark 很容易误判压缩器能力。进一步分析显示：增加输出 budget parameters at once and are heavily skewed toward “inappropriate to share” cases. As a result, high scores can reflect a generic refusal policy rather than true context sensitivity. The paper addresses how to build a controlled evaluation where a model must respond consistently to single-factor contextual changes, making correctness attributable to the intended CI parameter.","importance":"The main contribution is evaluation methodology rather than a new training recipe. ConCI turns CI assessment from independent item classification into controlled counterfactual consistency testing, which better separates “refusal bias” from genuine conditional norm understanding. The triplet-level joint scoring is a reusable pattern for other safety/permission settings (tool access, data minimization, authorization), and it provides a sharper diagnostic for whether post-training alignment signals actually teach conditional behavior.","technical_approach":"ConCI constructs anchor–counterfactual triplets from six existing CI benchmarks. For each anchor information flow (a vignette parameterized by CI roles/actors, data type, and transmission principle/purpose), the dataset perturbs exactly one CI parameter (notably recipient or purpose) while holding all others fixed. Two counterfactuals are generated per anchor: (1) a label-flipped variant where appropriateness should change, and (2) a label-held variant where appropriateness should remain the same. Evaluation uses a joint triplet metric: credit is given only if all three judgments are correct, directly testing sensitivity to the controlled change. Even the strongest model fails on roughly one-fifth of triplets. Errors are asymmetric: models are near-ceiling on inappropriate flows but substantially worse on appropriate flows; larger models reduce but do not eliminate this gap. improving model capability. It studies whether each LLM call site in agentic systems has a well-defined and actually enforced software contract. The central question is simple but important: once a program replaces deterministic logic with an LLM call, what guarantees correctness, safety, and policy compliance? In ordinary software, behavior is fixed by code and constrained by types, assertions, tests, and verification. For LLM calls, outputs are stochastic, input-steerable, and not exhaustively testable. So the guarantee must move into the surrounding program: preconditions before the call, constraints inside the prompt, and postconditions after the reply. The paper formalizes this as a call-site contract and asks, at scale, what these contracts should be, what is actually implemented, where the gaps are, and whether those gaps become real exploits at runtime.","importance":"This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for anyone thinking about the interface between model training and deployment. Second, the structure of these contracts suggests where training objectives and model interfaces should improve: structured outputs, schema adherence, refusal boundaries, tool-call validation, policy-aware decoding, and verifier placement. 前层。","importance":"对预训练研究的价值主要有三层。第一，它给 encoder-free 多模态预训练提供了机制层面的证据：统一 backbone 并不自动意味着从第一层开始就进行充分的早期融合，模型可能仍然选择先做模态内表征整理。第二，这个结果会影响架构与训练配方判断。如果早层确实在重复学习与专用 encoder 相似的表示，那么 encoder-free 的简洁性要和训练效率、参数利用率一起权衡。第三，它对跨模态统一建模有一个更细的启发：真正关键的也许不是“有没有 encoder”，而是“跨模态交互从哪一层开始、以什么强度开始”。这比把模型简单分成 encoder-based 和 encoder-free 更有研究价值。论文本身不是提出新预训练方法，而是对新范式做了较扎实的表征分析，因此更适合作为机制研究和架构设计参考。","technical_approach":"方法上，作者围绕“早层是否具备 encoder 行为”做了三组互相支撑的分析。第一组是上下文不变性测试。做法是固定锚定模态，例如语音，分别把同一段语音与中性文本+渐变图、转写提示词、情感识别提示词、真实照片，以及文本和图像同时变化的组合一起送入模型；然后在每一层提取语音 token 表示，用 CKA 比较不同上下文下表示与中性参考表示的相似度。如果早层已经发生强跨模态融合，那么同一语音在不同文本/图像上下文中的表示应当很早分化；相反，如果早层更像 encoder，相似度会在前若干层保持很高。第二组是 activation patching 风格的因果分析。作者不是只看表示相似，而是直接测试：在多模态推理任务中，若把各模态在前几层独立编码，到某一层之后再合并，性能是否接近从第一层就联合编码。若接近，说明前几层联合建模并非必要，支持“隐式 encoder”解释。第三组是把这些早层当作真正的 encoder 来评估。一方面用表示相似性分析，把模型早层的语音表示与 WavLM、HuBERT 等成熟语音 encoder 表征，而不只是某种偶然的中间态。","experiments":"文中最清楚的结果来自 Gemma-4 12B 的语音分析。作者从 LibriSpeech dev-clean 随机采样 1000 条语音，构造中性上下文与多种替代上下文，提取 48 层、每层 3840 维表示。结果显示，在 Gemma-4 12B 中，语音 token 表示对文本和图像上下文变化的 CKA 相似度在前 12 功能，但效率和专门化程度未必占优。论文的主结论因此不是 encoder-free 更好，而是 encoder-free 往往把 encoder 学习内化到了 backbone 早层。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先抓三处。第一，看引言和 Figure 1，对“上下文不变性”这个核心证据形成直观印象，尤其是 Gemma-4 12B 前 12 层高 CKA 的结果。第二，看 activation patching 或独立编码实验部分，这里决定论文是否只是做相关性分析，还是给出了一点因果支持。第三，看把早层当 encoder 做 benchmark 的章节，因为这部分最能帮助判断“隐式 chunks are fed directly into a unified Transformer, do the early layers actually perform early cross-modal fusion, or do they first reconstruct modality-specific encoders inside the backbone? The central hypothesis is that Gemma-4 12B and Inkling-Small learn “implicit encoders” in their lower layers, so audio and vision representations remain largely modality-internal for a substantial depth before stronger cross-modal interaction begins. This matters because it separates architectural appearance from functional behavior: removing an explicit encoder does not necessarily remove encoder-like computation.","importance":"For pretraining research, the contribution is mainly interpretive but still useful. A monolithic architecture is simpler on paper, but if the model relearns encoder-like features internally, the gain in modular simplicity may come with extra training cost or weaker specialization. Third, it suggests that the more meaningful design axis is not simply encoder-based versus encoder-free, but where fusion starts and how much modality-specific processing is preserved before fusion. Across 144 dataset-budget settings, Decoupled wins 54 cells, Joint wins 44, and Agent wins 46. This makes the choice of alignment paradigm a function of task format, label budget, and unimodal representation quality. Joint freezes a pair of jointly pretrained towers and trains a fusion head. Decoupled freezes independently pretrained unimodal encoders and trains only the downstream fusion module. Agent uses the same unimodal encoders as Decoupled, adds supervised unimodal readouts, and gives a frozen LLM task instructions, examples, available text, and readout outputs. For the fusion systems, the paper searches over eight standard fusion heads and selects checkpoints or hyperparameters using a fixed development split. The main claim is that failures are localized. A small set of diagnostic n-grams in RL rollouts strongly predicts incorrect outcomes. These n-grams are not treated as causal triggers; they are observable markers that the rollout has entered a region from which the policy rarely recovers.","importance":"The useful contribution for pretraining research is the feedback loop from RL failures to continued-pretraining data selection. Standard reasoning mid-training relies on large reasoning-heavy corpora chosen by task similarity or manual heuristics. This work instead mines the model’s own failed RL rollouts, retrieves matching pretraining text, and runs a small targeted continued-pretraining stage before repeating RL. The reported corpus is only about 35M tokens, far smaller than typical mid-training corpora. The score gains are modest, but the mechanism is valuable: RL can serve as a diagnostic tool for identifying missing pretraining coverage, not only as a post-training optimizer.","technical_approach":"The method has three stages. First, the authors run RLVR with GRPO and collect rollouts. They identify n-grams whose presence strongly predicts failure. For weaker models on elementary math, these are often reflection or self-correction phrases such as “let’s recheck”; for stronger models on broader reasoning suites, they can be more operation-specific, such as matrix inversion or reduced row echelon form. Second, they argue that these states are hard for on-policy RL to repair, because learning depends on successful continuations sampled from the current policy, and such continuations are rare after the failure-marked states. Third, they use the failure n-grams as exact-match queries over pretraining and mid-training corpora, continue pretraining on the retrieved text, and then rerun the same RL recipe. A matched control uses content-neutral queries from the same corpus with the same token budget.","experiments":"The experiments use OLMo2 and Qwen3 models across GSM8K, a mixed set containing GSM8K/Social IQA/MMLU/TriviaQA, and broader math-science reasoning tasks. Another useful result is transfer: a corpus mined from OLMo2-1B failures improves Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-4B by up to 2.4 points. 分数，以及高分但可疑的行为模式，自动写出负向 rubric，也就是“如果出现某种模式就扣分”的自然语言惩罚。第二，dynamic penalty buffer：不是把所有历史惩罚永久保留，而是维护一个在线缓冲区，持续加入新发现的 penalty，同时移除那些当前策略已不再触发的 penalty，避免奖励面被过时规则堆满。第三，penalty judge：对每条 rollout 检查 buffer 非常接近单位阵，真正被去掉的方向很少，所以“靠投影保护知识”这件事在默认配置里并不成立。第二，如果强行加大投影强度，确实能更强地保护旧知识，但会明显损害 edit efficacy 和 locality，说明硬子空间约束的代价很高。\n\n基于这个观察，作者把 preservation 重新表述成 regularization 小的参数更可塑，允许承担更多新事实写入。\n\n从优化形式看，FisherEdit 不是在 activation space 里做投影，而是在 parameter space 里解一个带 Fisher 加权二次正则的编辑目标。作者还给出 row-wise closed-form solver，使它在实现上保持接近 ROME/MEMIT/AlphaEdit 个偏好对，用剩余数据做标准 DPO。\n- Soft-Trim-K Robust-DPO：不硬删样本，而是对高影响度区域做平滑降权，形成从标准 DPO 到硬 trimming 的连续谱。\n4) 理论：给出在“任意固定攻击集合、大小≤K”的最坏情形下，梯度偏差的确定性上界，并把偏差分解为两部分：trimming/weighting 自身引入的偏差 + 剩余攻击造成的偏差。在进一步假设训练轨迹在参考参数附近的有界区域内时，推导全批梯度下降的时间一致（time-uniform）参数偏移与策略偏移界。\n5) 讨论正则：分析二次正则化版本，量化“曲率增加带来的稳定性”与“相对干净 DPO 引入额外 bias”的权衡。","experiments":"论文在 SHP、HH-RLHF、UltraFeedback-Binarized LLM can perform deeper multi-step search inside a single forward pass, without emitting intermediate chain-of-thought tokens. The task is framed as next-proof-step prediction: given premises and a target conclusion, the model must output the next valid step that lies on a proof path to the target. This isolates implicit reasoning from explicit reasoning-token expansion. The main finding is that curriculum learning can substantially extend the depth of implicit lookahead, but the learned depth appears to saturate at a model-dependent limit.","importance":"The contribution is most relevant to pretraining and reasoning mid-training because it treats reasoning depth as a trainable computational capability, not only as a property of decoding budget or post-training benchmarks. The results suggest that long-horizon reasoning failures can come from insufficient internal lookahead before the model commits to the next token. The paper also gives useful training-side regularities: curriculum granularity, model size, pretrained initialization, and compute all affect the attainable lookahead; achieved lookahead follows a saturating exponential trend with training compute. This is directly relevant for designing synthetic reasoning curricula, annealed reasoning data mixtures, and staged mid-training before RL. The main caveat is that the cleanest evidence comes from synthetic deductive data, although the authors do show transfer to natural-language reasoning benchmarks.","technical_approach":"$a7","experiments":"$a8","reading_guide":"Read the Introduction carefully for the distinction between implicit reasoning and chain-of-thought reasoning. In Methods, focus on the next-proof-step formulation, the definition of lookahead, and the decision to supervise only a single forward-pass output. Section 4.1 is the key evidence that the curriculum is doing real work, especially the comparison with non-curriculum and lookahead-only schedules. The central question is whether repeated application of the same block learns a reusable iterative algorithm, or whether it merely approximates a deeper untied stack with fewer parameters.","importance":"The relevance to pretraining is architectural. Looped Transformers offer a way to scale effective depth and test-time computation without increasing parameter count or emitting additional chain-of-thought tokens. The paper provides mechanistic evidence that weight tying changes the learning bias: in a controlled setting, looped models are more likely to learn stepwise hidden-state computation. This matters for latent reasoning, recurrent-depth Transformers, and models that aim to trade extra internal computation for better multi-step reasoning.","technical_approach":"The study uses directed permutation traversal. A prompt contains the shuffled edge list of a directed cycle, a start node, and a hop count H; the model must output the node reached after H applications of the permutation. Every intermediate node is known, but intermediate hops are not supervised during training. This makes it possible to test where each intermediate state becomes decodable inside the network. A looped model applies the same L-layer decoder block for T iterations, denoted L×T, with a learned iteration embedding. The untied baseline has L·T distinct layers and a single pass. Both are compared at matched effective depth D_eff=L·T. The mechanistic toolkit includes linear probes over hidden states, the model’s own logit lens, and activation patching to test causal use of intermediate states.","experiments":"The main task uses N=16 nodes and hop counts from 1 to 15. Because the cycle can make H forward hops equivalent to N-H backward hops, the internal analysis focuses on H≤8, and an N=32 comparison checks that the findings are not explained by shorter reverse walks. The key capability result is that looped models solve regimes where untied models trained under the same setup fail, even when the untied models have substantially more parameters, reported as up to eight times more. Untied models can be helped by lower learning rates or auxiliary intermediate supervision. Mechanistically, successful looped models show a staircase pattern: each iteration advances the computation by a regular number of hops, with the rate set by the iteration budget. Successful untied models do not show the same structure unless intermediate layers are explicitly supervised. Activation patching indicates that these intermediate loop states are causally used: replacing a state changes which walk the model completes.","reading_guide":"Plan for a 40–60 minute read. These embeddings condition the LLM’s reasoning. This differs from solver-based methods because the symbolic structure is used as an internal conditioning signal rather than as a complete external reasoning engine. It also differs from ordinary augmentation because equivalence is enforced at the representation level.","experiments":"The authors evaluate on curated data with logically equivalent variants. Strong LLMs show notable drops and prediction flips when the same underlying logic is expressed in different forms, and they generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. LoGIST improves consistency across equivalent inputs and improves generalization to unseen forms across multiple training strategies. The analysis further reports that the learned representation contains an approximately linear direction associated with logical composition, which helps explain its compositional behavior. The provided material does not include the full result tables or exact numbers, so no unverified metrics are added.","reading_guide":"Skim in roughly 25–35 minutes. Each pair contains one determinable and one undeterminable case, and both contain missing information. The model must identify which case is already decidable. Clinical scoring systems are a good substrate because they consist of item values and thresholds, so determinability can be assigned unambiguously even when some items are missing. The benchmark uses 15 guideline-recommended scoring systems with 4 to 9 scored items each. The central intervention adds one decision-relevant factor to one side while keeping the true determinability label unchanged. A matched intervention adds irrelevant text of comparable length. lens、以及多模态 token 的中间解码分析。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper examines a widely used but weakly justified assumption: whether zero-shot decoding of intermediate ViT patch tokens should naturally yield localized, human-interpretable semantics. In many analyses, one takes a patch token from an internal layer, applies the final classifier head or contrastive projection head, and interprets the resulting class score map as evidence of what the model “knows” at each spatial location. The paper shows that this assumption does not generally hold. Across real pretrained models, controlled synthetic settings, and a toy theoretical construction, the same transformer architecture can realize aligned explainability, inverted explainability, or no meaningful token-decoding explainability at all. The main claim is that token-decoding interpretability is not an inherent property of transformers; it is a fragile byproduct of training conditions and optimization bias.","importance":"Its relevance to foundation-model research is methodological rather than task-specific. The paper challenges a common habit in mechanistic analysis: treating direct decoding of hidden states as if it were a faithful window into internal semantics. For pretraining researchers, the key lesson is to separate two questions: whether information is present in the representation, and whether the native output head can read it out zero-shot in a human-aligned coordinate system. Those are not the same. The work also highlights that training objectives shape readout geometry. Classification losses and contrastive objectives can induce very different decoding behavior even when downstream performance is strong. This matters beyond ViTs: similar caution applies to logit-lens-style analyses in LLMs, to multimodal token decoding, and to non-AR objectives where the output head is not guaranteed to align with intermediate states in the same way.","technical_approach":"$cd","experiments":"$ce","reading_guide":"For a skim, focus on three parts. You do not need every proof detail on a first pass; the key idea is that the same optimal function can be represented in multiple internal coordinate systems, only some of which support intuitive zero-shot decoding. outcome 给奖励，或者只把 credit 分给改变 outcome 的关键步骤，都无法在 silent fork 上产生有效学习信号，因为这些分支的 value 相同，梯度天然消失。","importance":"对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain recipe，而是给 pretrain↔post-train 接口提供了一个很具体的信号：当模型被训练成 agent 后，很多行为质量问题并不体现在最终成功率上，而体现在“同样成功时怎么做”。这类问题如果只靠 outcome reward，很容易形成盲区。对做 RL post-training、agentic data synthesis、process supervision 的人，这篇文章的价值在于它把“学习信号应该放在哪里”说得很清楚：不是只看 outcome 改变处，而要看行为分叉处。这个判断对 coding agent 之外也有外溢意义，比如工具调用、长链推理、浏览器 agent 中的冗余检查、重复调用、保守过度等现象，很多都可能属于同一类 credit assignment 失配。","technical_approach":"技术上分三步。第一步是诊断。作者构造 behavioral checker，回放成功轨迹中的命令，跟踪仓库状态、已完成编辑、已执行检查，并把动作标成是否超出任务所需。然后在成功轨迹里定位“第一个偏离合比例行为的动作”，把它定义为 over-defense 的起点。进一步通过重采样前缀，验证这些点确实是 silent fork：后续行为不同，但 outcome 不变。\n\n第二步是解释为什么常见 RL 修补无效。最直接的想法是把 checker 输出并入 trajectory reward，对过度防御加惩罚。问题在于，这种奖励只有当整条轨迹在所有 silent fork 上都走了合比例分支时，才会把差异传回早期 fork；任务一长，这种“全程都对”的轨迹组合概率迅速下降。再叠加 GRPO 这类组内相对奖励算法，只在同组 rollout 奖励有差异时更新，很多组会完全没有学习信号。\n\n第三步是方法设计：ForkDPO。作者不再从 outcome 反推 credit，而是直接在 fork 处构造 preference pair。具体有两类 pair。其一是过度防御侧：checker 找到成功轨迹中第一个不合比例动作，从同一前缀重采样得到更合比例的替代动作，形成 chosen/rejected。其二是欠防御侧：对于那些如果直接提交会跳过必要检查的 silent fork，也构造另一侧的 pair，避免模型被训练成一味少检查。然后在这些 fork-level pair 上做 DPO。这个设计和随机抽取 turn 做 DPO 的区别很关键：监督信号被精确放在行为真正分叉的位置，而不是平均撒在整条轨迹上。","experiments":"实验重点有三层。第一层是现象测量。作者在 4B 模型和 4 个 frontier 模型上观察到，silent fork 几乎就是 over-defense 的起点；在隐式预算设置下，把这些 fork A frozen context encoder LLM reads only the context. At selected layer pairs, learned compressors use slot queries and cross-attention over encoder token states to produce a fixed number of low-dimensional slots. These slots form a compressed packet. A frozen receiver LLM reads only the prompt or question, then uses reader cross-attention to access the packet at selected layers. Prompt-conditioned gates control the contribution of each slot, so different questions can use different parts of the same packet. Compared with KV-cache reuse, the packet has fixed size and can be consumed by another model. Compared with ICAE-style compression, the LLM weights remain frozen and cross-family communication is supported. 空间做检索，文本和图像的对应关系往往过于松散；如果完全转成文本，又会损失视觉细节。共享 SAE 概念层试图在两者之间取平衡。\n\n第二步是构建 query-conditioned memory graph。通过这些共享概念地址，系统把视觉证据和其所属对话轮次动态连接起来，并把时间戳、会话上下文、跨轮依赖编码进图结构。作者强调 temporal neuro-symbolic，不是显式逻辑程序，而是用稀疏概念地址和图结构提供可组合、可追踪的关系骨架，再由底层多模态 LM 完成连续表示上的融合与生成。和 flat cross-modal fusion 相比，LMMR 的区别在于它把 memory organization 当成独立问题处理，而不是把检索结果直接塞给 backbone。","experiments":"实验在 假设、以及训练-部署分布偏移是同一类问题。更重要的是，作者没有停留在“更难数据会让模型更差”这种结论，而是进一步证明：仅把训练数据换成弱用户对话，并不会自动带来鲁棒性提升。也就是说，问题不只是数据分布，而是训练目标没有把正确的中间状态建模出来。StaGPO 的意义就在这里：它把 agent 显式写出的 need-gap-fill 状态当作 rollout 间的分组键，用组内回报比较来构造 去让用户“更含糊”，因为那会同时改变用户知道什么、想要什么、如何回应，导致实验解释混杂。这里采用的是后处理式信道退化：把用户每轮回复切成句子，再以概率 p 独立替换成 [inaudible]，p 取 0、0.2、0.4，控制 token/句级信息丢失，同时保持任务、用户内部状态、奖励函数和训练 recipe 不变。更重要的是，simulator 仍然看到未遮蔽历史，因此它像真实用户一样“以为自己已经说清楚了”，只有 agent 接收到退化后的文本。这样作者可以同时记录 what was said 和 what was heard，并做 counterfactual fork，分析到底是哪一处信息丢失导致失败。\n\n第二部分是 StaGPO。标准 GRPO 在对话级别给 advantage，整段轨迹共享同一个终局信号，因此在弱用户场景里很难把失败归因到“哪一轮没有识别缺失信息”或“哪一次追问是有效的”。StaGPO 先要求 agent 在每次行动前写一个结构化状态，包含三类内容：任务需要用户提供什么、当前还缺什么、这些缺口正在如何被填补。作者不把这个 written state 当作额外监督目标去直接优化准确率，因为附录实验表明，单独奖励 state accuracy 或 repair 行为要么过稀疏，要么与最终成功率不对齐，反而干扰训练。StaGPO 的关键改动是把这个 state 当作 grouping key：把不同 rollout 中落到相同 need-gap-fill 状态的 turn 归为一组，再比较这些 turn 之后的 discounted return，形成一种无需 critic 的 step-level 相对优势估计。这样 没有在正确时点识别真正缺失的字段；盲目多问只增加交互，不增加有效恢复。文中还提到，agent 对缺失信息的识别很差：它会把大约一半其实已经收到的信息也误判为缺失；即便显式告诉它哪些字段缺失，也未必能据此采取更好的动作。\n\nStaGPO 的结果主要体现在 ToolWOZ 上更清楚。按论文描述，在“用训练时同类用户评测”的设定下，StaGPO 对 ToolWOZ 上所有训练 plain text answers. Prior work mainly studied single-turn QA, where a poisoned model appears safe at release but harmful behavior emerges after benign downstream fine-tuning. Here the authors ask two sharper questions. First, does dormant poisoning transfer to agentic settings, including multimodal agents, and can the activated behavior generalize to unseen harmful actions? Second, can downstream users defend against such activation without relying on externally curated safe responses or a trusted clean reference model, both of which are often unavailable in open-model fine-tuning pipelines?","importance":"This is more of a safety and post-training paper than a pretraining paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it exposes a stability problem in parameter space. A model can look aligned at release while still containing latent harmful behaviors that become reachable under later benign optimization. That has implications for continual fine-tuning, open-weight deployment, and how robustly alignment constraints are encoded. benchmark，而是训练世界生成器。","experiments":"合成结果方面，作者最终得到 341 个 environment-task 对。每个任务都要求至少三种接口类型参与，流程较长，部分任务需要 100 步以上。难度上，frontier 模型 GPT-6-Astra 的成功率也只有约 60%，说明任务不是模板化的低难度脚本。\n\n训练方面，作者在两个 Qwen 模型上做在线 weakness of low-rank gradient-subspace optimization for LLM training: the principal gradient subspace is not static. Methods in the GaLore family rely on the observation that gradients are largely concentrated in a low-dimensional subspace, but they usually refresh that subspace only periodically, often via expensive SVD recomputation, implicitly assuming it stays valid for a while. Other methods, such as OSD, add a secondary optimization loop to chase the moving subspace. The paper argues, with explicit empirical evidence, that after warm-up the gradient subspace in LLM training typically drifts slowly and smoothly rather than jumping erratically. If that is true, then the right problem is not repeated cold-start estimation but online tracking. 必须跨整网保存到反传结束，这让深层模型、长序列和大 batch 都直接受限。已有 local learning 方法往往用局部辅助损失训练每一层或每一块，但这些局部目标和全局任务梯度之间缺少严格对应，所以一旦网络变深，误差会快速累积。作者要解决的核心不是再设计一个经验上可用的 local loss，而是构造一种有明确梯度近似含义的局部替代：每个 block 只看本地激活，通过一个 proxy 去预测全局输出，再用 proxy 内部反传来近似真实的全局梯度。","importance":"对预训练研究的意义主要在训练系统和优化接口，而不在直接改进语言建模目标。它给出了一条不同于 activation checkpointing、recompute、ZeRO、低精度压缩的路线：不是继续为 backprop 节省内存，而是从训练信号本身改写反传依赖。这个方向如果能继续成立，价值在三点。第一，它把“局部更新”从经验技巧推进到可分析的梯度估计框架，至少在深线性网络和残差占优的非线性网络里有理论支撑。第二，它对长上下文和深层 Transformer 的 memory wall 有直接相关性，因为 locality 的定义就是一次只保留一个 block 的激活。第三，它在 LLM 微调场景里已经显示出比零阶方法更好的精度/内存/时间折中，这说明它不是只在小模型玩具实验里成立。不过要注意，当前证据还停留在 memory-efficient finetuning，不是大规模从头预训练；因此它更像一个值得跟踪的训练范式候选，而不是已经可替代标准预训练 recipe 的方案。","technical_approach":"方法叫 ProxyProp。做法是把深层 Transformer 划分成多个 gradient-isolated blocks。第 l 个 block 的输入是 h_{l-1}，输出是 h_l。标准 backprop 需要通过后续所有 block 把最终损失对 h_l 的梯度传回来；ProxyProp 则给每个 block 额外挂一个本地 proxy network，输入 h_l，目标是预测全模型最终输出，训练信号来自对全局输出的蒸馏。然后该 block 的参数更新不再依赖真实下游网络的反传，而是把损失先对 proxy 输出求导，再经由 proxy 对 h_l 反传，得到对 block 参数的局部梯度估计。\n\n关键点不只是“加一个辅助头”，而是作者把 proxy 设计成对全局 Jacobian 的局部估计器。在线性网络里，若 proxy 是线性的，最优 proxy 会隐式学到从当前 block 表示到最终输出的期望线性映射，因此局部梯度与真实全局梯度一致。对非线性残差网络，作者强调 residual parameterization 很重要：当 skip connection 主导时，block 到输出的映射更接近恒等加小扰动，proxy 的梯度误差可被界定；在初始化附近，局部梯度甚至可以与真实梯度精确对齐。这个分析解释了为什么方法更适合现代残差 Transformer，而不是任意深层非残差网络。\n\n训练流程上，block 在前向后即可立刻更新，不需要等待整网 backward，因此满足 decoupled / unlocked learning 的定义。内存节省来自两部分：一是不再保存整网 activation；二是每次只需保留单个 block 及其 proxy 的局部计算图。与传统 local loss 方法相比，区别在于 ProxyProp 的目标不是让每层直接完成分类或重建，而是逼近“如果继续经过后续网络，最终会对输出产生什么影响”。与 MeZO 这类零阶优化相比，ProxyProp 仍然使用梯度信息，只是梯度来自局部代理，因此在相近内存预算下通常更高效。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验分成两类。第一类是视觉 Transformer 上的监督学习，用来系统比较不同 block 划分下的 memory-accuracy trade-off。作者的结论是，ProxyProp 在多种 partition 方式下都优于已有局部学习算法：同等内存下精度更高，或同等精度下内存更低。这里真正值得看的不是单一最好点，而是随着 block 数增加、locality 变强时，性能退化是否平滑；作者声称 ProxyProp 的退化更慢，说明梯度近似比传统 local objectives 更稳。\n\n第二类是 LLM 的 memory-efficient finetuning。作者把 ProxyProp 和 MeZO 做对比，结论是：在可比显存成本下，ProxyProp 的下游性能更高；即便 MeZO 使用约 8 倍计算时间，结果仍不如 ProxyProp。这个对比很关键，因为零阶方法常被当作极低显存微调的备选，但代价是方差大、收敛慢。ProxyProp 说明“局部一阶近似”可能是更合理的低显存路径。\n\n不过，当前公开内容里没有足够完整的数值表来复述所有具体数字，例如 ViT 的具体模型规模、数据集、不同 partition 的精度差值、LLM 微调所用参数量和任务集合。阅读时应重点核对实验章节中的三类细节：1）显存统计是否包含 optimizer state、activation、proxy 额外开销；2）时间开销是 wall-clock 还是 FLOPs；3）LLM 微调是否只覆盖 PEFT/adapter 场景，还是更新全参数。若是后者，意义会更大。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先抓理论，再看实验边界。优先看 Introduction 里对 locality、decoupling、unlocked training 的定义，因为这决定了作者到底在和谁比较。然后直接看理论部分关于两件事的证明：一是深线性网络中 Standard backpropagation requires storing activations across the whole network until gradients are propagated from the final loss. 可能在更深层才变得与当前文本查询相关；如果允许它们后续回流，又会遇到另一个问题——这些 token 跳过了中间若干层，隐藏状态停留在旧深度，和当前层的活跃 token 不在同一个表示空间。论文把这两个问题拆开来看：一是“相关性随深度变化”，二是“回流 token 的表示过时”。核心目标不是提出新的训练范式，而是在不改模型参数、不重新训练的前提下，让可恢复的视觉 token 设计都有参考价值。第二，论文明确指出“可恢复路由”真正难的不是把 token 存起来，而是如何补偿它错过的表示演化；这相当于把层间状态迁移当成一个近似问题来处理。若以后做训练期动态 token 计算、跨层跳连压缩、或 unified multimodal token budget 分配，这个视角是有用的。","technical_approach":"方法叫 CatchUp，核心是 depth-aware re-admission。它不是一次性决定保留哪些视觉 token，而是在若干选定 decoder 层重新做 query-conditioned relevance 评估。具体做法分三步。第一步，在路由层用最后一个文本 token 到各视觉 token 的注意力作为相关性代理，选出当前要激活的视觉 token，其余 token 不删除，而是 deferred。第二步，在两个路由层之间，只让被选中的视觉 token 继续经过后续 decoder 计算，从而减少 attention、FFN 和 KV cache 开销。第三步，当某个 deferred token 在更深层再次被选中时，不直接拿它旧的 hidden state 回来，而是做一次“catch-up”更新，近似它在被跳过层中本该经历的表示变化。\n\n论文的关键创新在第三步。作者先用 full-token reference trajectory 做分析，发现如果把回流 token 的 stale state 替换成同深度 oracle state，性能会明显恢复，这证明问题确实出在表示失配。于是 CatchUp 用“reference-to-current transition signals”来近似这个缺失的演化。直观上，它会从语义和空间上相近的活跃视觉 token 中提取从参考深度到当前深度的状态变化，再把这种变化迁移到回流 token 上。也就是说，它不是重新计算被跳过的所有层，而是借邻近 token 的演化轨迹做插值式补偿。论文强调这是 training-free 的，因此它和需要额外蒸馏或轻量适配器训练的方法不同。\n\n与已有方法相比，区别很清楚。相对 irreversible pruning，它允许晚出现的重要视觉证据重新进入计算图；相对 recoverable routing 但不做状态修正的方法，它解决了 re-admission 后 hidden state 过时的问题。作者还专门用 oracle 实验说明：如果只允许回流但不修正状态，收益有限；如果状态能对齐到当前深度，性能会显著更好，说明 CatchUp 的设计点是对的。","experiments":"实验主要在 LLaVA-1.5-7B 上做，重点覆盖 referring-expression grounding 和通用多模态基准。动机实验先给出两个很有信息量的统计。其一，在 RefCOCO 的 500 个样本、576 个视觉 token、top-64 相关 token 的设定下，相邻 decoder 层之间的 top-K token 集合平均波动率达到 28.85%，说明相关证据在层间变化很快。其二，以第 2 层作为早期选择参考，late-emerging evidence ratio 在第 7 层就超过 50%，到第 31 层达到 99.42%，也就是后期最相关的 token 几乎都不在早期 top-K 里。这直接否定了“早剪枝后一路沿用”的静态假设。\n\n主结果上，CatchUp 在相同 routing budget 下取得了被比较方法里最好的 grounding 保留率；在 matched prefill computation 的设置下，它使用最少的视觉 token 和最小的 decoder KV-cache，同时相对 dense inference 带来 8.0% 的端到端时延下降。论文摘要和正文都强调它在两个 benchmark group 上平均 retention 最高。虽然给出的公开片段里没有完整表格数值，但结论很明确：它不是单纯追求更激进压缩，而是在相同预算下把精度损失压得更低。\n\n消融方面，最值得注意的是 oracle state replacement。作者把回流 token 的 stale state 直接替换成 full-token 轨迹中同层的真实状态，grounding 性能显著提升，证明“状态陈旧”是 recoverable routing 的主要瓶颈，而不是回流机制本身无效。另一个关键消融是不同 catch-up 信号来源：语义邻近和空间邻近是互补的，只靠其中一种通常不如联合使用。还有路由层位置和预算的实验，显示过早、过少的路由决策会错过后期证据，而过于频繁的重评估又会侵蚀效率收益，说明该方法依赖一个比较平衡的 routing schedule。","reading_guide":"这篇适合泛读，不需要逐式推导。建议先看 Introduction 和 Motivating Observations，重点看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2。这里已经把论文最重要的经验事实讲清楚：视觉 token 的相关性是深度相关的，而且 stale state 会伤性能。然后看方法部分里关于 deferred The paper isolates these as two separate issues: relevance is depth-dependent, and re-admitted tokens are representation-misaligned. 生成的片段被直接拼到上下文里，不共享 logits、hidden states 或参数，因此兼容黑盒 target，也区别于 speculative decoding 那种逐段验证机制。\n\n论文的关键在 trigger policy。作者先系统检验了直觉上最自然的一类信号：当前 token 的 entropy、negative log-likelihood、logit margin、top-k prompt，又会把本来应该由模型自己完成的设计决策提前泄露。论文把这个张力明确分成两个维度：一是选哪些标识符暴露给模型，二是对每个标识符暴露到什么程度。它要解决的不是单纯提高 coding benchmark 的 solve rate，而是让 benchmark 更准确地测“实现能力”而不是“猜隐藏接口”或“吃提示”。","importance":"对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对代码模型和 agent 的评测设计很有参考价值。原因有两点。第一，repo-level benchmark 已经在反向塑造模型训练目标，尤其是代码 agent 的数据合成、SFT 和 RL 奖励设计；如果 benchmark 本身混入大量 spoiler，训练出来的能力会偏向利用提示而不是真实实现。第二，这篇工作提醒一个常被忽略的问题：更高的 pass rate 不一定意味着 benchmark 更好，也不一定意味着模型更强，可能只是评测输入泄露了更多参考解信息。这个判断对做 post-train 数据构造、verifier 设计、以及代码任务 curriculum 都有现实意义。","technical_approach":"方法上，论文先给出一个很有用的分析框架：把 identifier hints 拆成 selection 和 projection。Selection 决定暴露哪些程序实体，比如新增文件、函数、类、属性、编辑位置；projection 决定对这些实体暴露哪些属性，比如名字、签名、位置、语义描述、实现指导。现有 benchmark 往往把两者混在一起，因此不同 hint scheme 的效果很难归因。\n\n在这个框架下，作者提出两套策略。第一是 DefUse selection。它不试图把参考实现里所有新增组件都告诉模型，而是优先选择那些位于“实现与测试交互边界”的标识符，也就是测试真正会调用、引用、检查的接口实体。这个思路比“暴露所有新增组件”更克制，因为 benchmark 真正需要消除的是测试接口层面的猜测，而不是把内部实现结构也一并公开。\n\n第二是 Declaration projection。对于被选中的实体，只暴露 declaration 级别的信息，例如名称、类型、签名、所在文件或位置等接口属性，但避免给出语义解释、行为描述、实现建议等更接近参考解设计意图的内容。这样做的目标是只解决 hidden interface mismatch，不替模型做设计。\n\n论文还把已有 benchmark 的 hint 方案放进这个二维坐标系里比较，强调 selection 和 projection 必须分开做 controlled comparison。除此之外，作者引入了一个 LLM-based judge 来评估 hint 的三个属性：这些信息是否是完成任务所必需、是否泄露了参考解中的实现选择、是否对模型行为形成了额外指导。这个 judge 不是替代执行评测，而是补充 solve rate 无法揭示的信息泄露程度。","experiments":"实验覆盖五个 repository-level coding benchmark，横跨 Python 和 Java，并在三种语言模型上比较不同 hint policy。全文的重点不是追求单一最高分，而是看不同 selection/projection 组合如何改变“解题率”和“信息泄露”之间的平衡。\n\n主要结论有几条。第一，性能提升经常伴随更高程度的 solution disclosure。也就是说，一些 hint scheme 之所以让模型分数更高，不一定是因为它们更好地消除了 under-specification，也可能是因为它们把原本应由模型完成的设计决策提前告诉了模型。第二，把 selection 和 projection 分开后，可以看到两者对结果的影响并不等价：暴露哪些实体，与暴露这些实体到什么粒度，都会显著改变 benchmark 难度和测量对象。第三，DefUse + Declaration 这一组合在作者的分析里更接近一个折中点：它能减少因隐藏接口造成的无谓失败，同时比更激进的 hint 方案少泄露实现语义和行为指导。\n\n论文还做了 hint attribute ablation，分析名称、签名、位置、语义描述等不同属性各自带来的影响；并在 SWE-bench Pro 上用 LLM judge 进一步检查哪些属性属于必要接口信息，哪些已经开始接近 spoiler。给出的核心洞察不是某个绝对数字，而是 benchmark 设计不能只看 solve rate 排名，必须同时看 disclosure profile。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2，先把 guesswork 与 spoilers 的问题设定吃透。然后看方法部分里 selection / projection 强化拒答或安全完成；对 benign prompt 则避免过强安全约束伤害有用性。具体上使用 category-aware rewards，并把 KL anchoring 主要施加在 benign prompts 上，而不是对所有样本统一收紧。这样做的动机很明确：如果 harmful 和 benign 都被同一套保守约束驱动，模型容易学成普遍拒答；把两类样本解耦后，安全优化和能力保持的目标冲突会小一些。全文的理论部分还分析了为什么 entropy bonus 在 relative advantage 消失时会放大 unsafe diversification，这一点是方法设计的重要依据。","experiments":"实验覆盖四个模型变体，包括 Qwen3 和 是否仍然存在。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper studies a specific failure mode of GRPO-based safety alignment for large reasoning models. GRPO depends on within-group reward differences to produce policy gradients. In safety alignment, however, rollouts from the same prompt often become behaviorally homogeneous: many sampled responses are all unsafe, or all lie on the same side of the safety boundary. Once the reward variance inside a group collapses, the normalized advantages vanish and GRPO stops receiving meaningful safety-directed updates. The authors identify two concrete consequences. The second is unsafe diversification, where entropy regularization keeps encouraging exploration after the relative signal disappears, causing the model to spread probability mass over more diverse unsafe responses rather than becoming safer.","importance":"This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. A narrow SFT policy can produce homogeneous samples; under group-relative reward normalization, groups that are all correct or all incorrect yield no useful learning signal. The useful implication is that reasoning SFT data should contain structurally different correct derivations, not just correct answers or paraphrased explanations.","technical_approach":"The proposed method, EquivAug, generates diverse and verifiable reasoning paths through symbolic equivalence transformations. It first converts natural-language CoT solutions into a formal or symbolic representation, then applies equivalence-preserving transformations such as algebraic rewrites or logical equivalences, and finally reconstructs the transformed derivation as natural-language reasoning. Qwen3.8-27B 把每个自然语言步骤解析成一个 operation 加 payload。operation 一共七类：Derive、Assume、Verify、Prune、Confirm、Restate、Meta。payload 是去表述差异后的规范化内容，比如事实、数值、动作、子目标、假设或答案。这样“Bob lives in the fifth house”和“house 5’s name is Bob”会落到同一个原子表示上。第二段是 deterministic engine。它不再调用模型，而是把 parser 输出按顺序回放到当前树状态上，解析该步骤应当附着到哪个节点，并执行相应 mutation。因为这一步是确定性的，所以同样的 parse 会得到同样的树和同样的 failure label。第三段是 failure attribution。作者不把 failure 定义成一句话本身的属性，而是定义成 predicate(step, resolved node, prior tree)。这样三大失败模式——repetition、underthinking、unsupported deduction——都能进一步拆成若干子类型，并且每个标签都能指出它是相对于哪个先前状态成立的。方法上的关键区别有两点：第一，它把“推理内容”与“推理操作”分开，先做 wording-invariant canonicalization，再做状态更新；第二，它把 failure 从文本分类问题改成状态机上的关系判定问题，因此能区分局部文本相似但功能不同的步骤。文中还强调，只有 parser 用到 LLM，后续 replay 和 labeling 都是可复现的，这一点对构建大规模过程数据很重要。","experiments":"实验覆盖三类结构差异较大的任务：ZebraLogic 约束满足、24 Game 算术组合搜索、PlanBench 带前置条件的顺序规划。parser 在人工裁决参考标签上的准确率在每个任务都达到 0.89 以上，这是整套框架可用的前提。核心结果有三类。第一，ARBOR 对失败的识别明显优于局部信号。作者比较了重复检测的 n-gram / embedding 相似度、切换词启发式、step correctness judge、以及若干 block-level label；结论是这些局部方法只能找回 ARBOR 标出的很小一部分失败步骤，而且误报里相当多是正常推理。更重要的是，ARBOR 的分 subtype 计数比把所有局部信号合起来，更能区分正确轨迹和错误轨迹。第二，不同 failure subtype 的代价不同。unsupported deduction 更直接伤害正确率，因为模型后续验证很少能把这种“状态并不支持的推出”纠正掉；underthinking 主要浪费搜索预算，常见情况是模型先放弃一条仍可成功的分支，后来又绕路回来或从别的路径到达答案，因此更多损失在 token 和时间，而不是最终正确率；repetition 对答案伤害最小，额外 token 成本也相对有限，通常只是把很早前提出过的结果重新建立一遍。第三，failure precursor 主要存在于树状态而不是单步标签里。作者分析了每种 subtype 发生前的 at-risk steps，发现决定因素往往是当前 branch 的内容、当前节点是否已被验证、以及最近一段操作序列。仅靠 operation label 只能恢复最后一种，而前两种恰好对应那些会影响 correctness 或浪费可行搜索工作的失败。摘要里没有给出完整表格数字，但文中主张这些结论在三类任务上都稳定成立，且 subtype 粒度比粗粒度 failure mode 更有解释力。","reading_guide":"这篇适合泛读但要抓住方法定义。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 候选；候选可能修改提示词、上下文组织、工具使用流程、反馈暴露方式、终止规则等。然后在一个 search set 上评估这些候选，选出当前最优 harness。P-step 固定新 harness，在其下用强化学习更新 policy。更新后的 policy 再成为下一轮 harness proposer，同时上一轮训练中识别出的 hard tasks 被拿来构成下一轮 harness 搜索集，使 都不够。方法部分重点看 H-step 和 P-step 的接口：失败轨迹如何被总结成 harness revision proposal，候选 harness 如何筛选，RL 在固定 harness 下如何训练，以及 hard-task search set 如何更新。实验部分建议优先看三类结果：一是 Self-HPO 相对 policy-only / harness-only 的增益；二是 变更空间的定义，因为这决定方法能否推广。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper targets a coupled optimization problem in coding agents: policy and harness co-determine performance, so improving only one side is inherently limited. A fixed harness constrains which behaviors the policy can express and learn from, while a fixed policy makes harness search chase outdated failure modes. The core question is how to let both components evolve recursively, with the current policy itself driving harness improvement rather than relying on a permanently external proposer.","importance":"This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface and to agentic training more broadly. In coding agents, a large fraction of gains often comes from harness design—prompting, tool mediation, feedback exposure, and termination logic—rather than from the base model alone. attention，让注意力更集中；另一类是擦除或抑制竞争项目的内容表示，直接减少干扰。如果前者收益小、后者收益大，就说明瓶颈不在定位而在内容混叠。论文给出的结论正是后者更有效。\n\n第四步是用从零训练的小 transformer 做边界条件分析。作者发现单层 attention 模型确实更符合 precision account，因为它只能靠一次 softmax 直接完成位置选择与内容汇聚，邻位竞争会直接造成检索模糊；但加到两层后，模型可以先做较粗定位，再在后续层中重组和净化表示，precision 限制不再是主导因素，错误模式转向 interference。这个对照很重要，因为它解释了为什么一些早期小模型分析会得出“softmax 精度瓶颈”的结论，而这结论不能直接外推到现代多层 LLM。","experiments":"实验覆盖 15 个预训练 LLM，来自 3 个模型家族，规模从 70M 到 14B，外加从头训练的最小化 transformer。任务序列长度为 24，从 20 个辅音字母中采样；每个测试序列包含 4 个 lure；每个模型、每个 N 在 200 条 calibration 序列上定阈值，再在 1000 条独立测试序列上评估。论文首先复现了经典现象：随着 N 增大，d′ 下降，错误集中在 N±1 这类邻近 lure 的区分信息，甚至在模型最终答错的试次上仍然成立，说明信息在表示中存在，但没有被正确转成输出。其三，因果干预里，删除竞争项内容带来的性能改善显著大于单纯 sharpen attention，支持“读出瓶颈”而非“检索瓶颈”。其四，尺度分析显示，这个结论在 200 倍参数跨度上都成立；随着模型变大，任务会分散到更多 heads 上，但瓶颈位置没有变。其五，小模型对照显示单层 transformer 的确受 precision 限制，而第二层足以明显缓解这一限制。摘要里没有给出完整数表，全文的价值更多在图表中的模式一致性和干预前后差异，而不是单个 benchmark 数字。","reading_guide":"泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看引言里对 precision account 和 interference account 变体中识别“可复现、方向一致、能在留出变体上继续成立”的表示重分布，并把这种重分布与下游线性 readout 的变化、以及最终决策失败区分开来。","importance":"它对预训练研究不是直接改进训练 recipe，而是提供了一种更稳的机制分析工具。当前很多 SAE 分析容易停留在个例 feature 叙事：某个 prompt 改写后 feature A 降了、feature B 升了，于是推断模型内部机制发生了什么。问题是这种结论常常不稳，换个同义改写就可能不复现。作者提出的 RSS 试图把“单次观察”提升为“跨变体可重复的支持集”，这对 interpretability、对齐审计、prompt robustness 分析都更有用。对基座研究员来说，价值在于方法论：如果想用 SAE 去研究 tokenizer 变化、数据风格变化、指令模板变化如何影响内部表示，先要有一个能区分偶然扰动和稳定重分布的统计对象。论文还进一步把表示变化和 readout 贡献拆开，提醒人不要把 feature 变化直接等同于行为原因。","technical_approach":"方法核心是 Redistribution Sensitivity Score，简称 RSS。它不是简单找变化最大的 feature，而是同时要求三个条件：变化幅度大、在多个变体上反复出现、并且方向一致。具体做法是：对某个 clean prompt 及其一组 transformed variants，在目标位置计算每个 SAE feature 的激活变化。先用平均绝对变化 h_f 形成候选池，避免正负抵消；再统计每个 feature 在多少个观测上超过阈值 τ，以及这些响应是否大多同向，得到 recurrence r_f 和 consistency c_f。只有满足 r_f≥ρ、c_f≥κ 的 feature 才有资格进入支持集，最后从中取变化幅度最大的前 K 个，形成 responsive support S。MeanRSS 则用来汇总这个支持集的平均响应强度。\n\n这里有两个设计点值得注意。第一，选择和评估分离。支持集和方向是在 selector variants 上固定出来的，然后在 disjoint held-out variants 上直接评估，不重新挑 feature。这避免了“看过测试集再讲故事”。第二，RSS 的定义不使用 readout 权重，因此它先回答“哪些表示变化是稳定的”，再单独分析“这些变化是否影响某个下游线性 readout”。\n\n在 readout 分析部分，作者对固定线性 probe 做精确分解：某个 recurrent feature change 对 logit 的贡献，取决于激活变化大小、对应 readout weight、方向是否对齐，以及 clean prompt 原本离决策阈值还有多远。这样就把三件事拆开了：表示重分布、readout 分数变化、最终 threshold crossing。这个拆分很重要，因为一个 feature 可以稳定变化，但若 readout 权重很小或多个 feature 贡献互相抵消，就未必导致行为失败。\n\n论文还给出有限样本下的方向稳定性保证。比如 n=5、ρ=κ=0.8 时，入选 feature 至少有 4 次同向响应、至多 1 次反向，因此删掉一次观测也不至于翻转方向。这种约束让“稳定重分布”这个对象更像一个可复验的 support，而不是一次性排序结果。","experiments":"实验覆盖 27 个预训练 SAE，来自 8 个语言模型。作者考察的是 prompt transformation 引起的表示重分布是否能在留出变体上复现，以及这种复现能否解释冻结安全 readout 的变化。主要结果有三类。\n\n第一，RSS 选出的支持集在 held-out variants 上仍呈现可重复的 redistribution profile，说明它抓到的不是 selector 集上的偶然 feature 波动。第二，在两个冻结的 safety readout 审计任务上，虽然 RSS 选 support 时完全不看 readout 信息，但这些 support 仍能重建相当大一部分 held-out logit change，说明 recurrent representation change 与下游读出确实存在稳定联系。第三，把 RSS support 与 clean margin 结合后，可以较好地预测 recurrent failure。文中给出的数字是：两个任务上，median support size 分别为 20 和 19 个 feature，得到的 recurrent failure AUROC 分别为 0.935 和 0.958；而使用 full erosion 的 AUROC 为 0.965 和 0.964。这个差距不大，说明很小的 recurrent support 已经保留了大部分审计效用。\n\n从实验解读看，最有意思的不是 AUROC 本身，而是作者证明了“稳定表示变化”和“行为失败”之间并非一一对应：有些 recurrent changes 只改变 readout 分数但不越阈值，有些则需要结合 clean margin 才能解释失败。这让 SAE 分析从‘找 feature’推进到‘找 feature 如何通过 readout 影响决策’。","reading_guide":"这篇适合泛读，但要抓住方法边界。先看 Introduction 和 Method，弄清作者为什么要把 redistribution、readout contribution、decision failure 分开。然后重点看 RSS 的定义：候选池、recurrence、directional consistency、support 表达式回答；只有当两段表达式在每条记录上逐项一致，并且计算结果不是库中已有能力的重复时，答案才被保留。外层循环负责发现能力缺口：当模型不断提出当前算子闭包无法表达的问题时，它会归纳缺失能力，编写新算子。新算子的准入门槛包括两点：第一，模型要独立写出两个实现，两个实现必须在验证集上逐条一致；第二，算子要满足由已信任算子表达的守恒律，例如按组求和的结果加总后应等于全局总和。所有表达式都在沙箱 DSL The hard part is admitting new operators without letting wrong capabilities enter the library.","importance":"This is not a direct pretraining paper, but it is relevant to training-loop design. It replaces reward-driven self-improvement with an admission rule based on executable agreement and conservation constraints. The useful lesson is about signal quality: when models generate their own tasks, tools, or skills, the main bottleneck is not only generation volume but also whether new capabilities have a checkable gate. The inner loop keeps the operator set fixed. It proposes new questions and accepts an answer only when two independently generated DSL expressions, written from the question, agree on every record and compute something not already covered. The outer loop searches for gaps in the current closure. When repeated questions require a missing capability, the model proposes a new operator. Admission requires two independent implementations to agree on a finite validation set and to satisfy conservation laws expressible using trusted operators, such as grouped totals summing back to a global total. retention in ultra-low-bit weight quantization. Below four bits, perplexity can remain tolerable while factual knowledge and task accuracy degrade sharply. Training ternary models from scratch or with long quantization-aware procedures is expensive, while cheap post-training conversion loses much of the model’s knowledge. RoleQ aims to convert existing LLM checkpoints to ternary weights at low conversion cost while retaining more of the original capability.","importance":"The useful contribution for pretraining-oriented work is the functional view of quantization format. Scale placement is treated as a property of Transformer read/write units rather than as a row-or-column convention inherited from matrix layout. Vectors that read from the residual stream get one scale per output unit; vectors that write to the residual stream get one scale per input unit. This is relevant for low-bit pretraining, quantization-aware training, and direct training of ternary or near-ternary models. It also reinforces a practical evaluation lesson: perplexity alone is not enough for judging sub-4-bit models; knowledge-heavy metrics need to be tracked.","technical_approach":"RoleQ introduces role-aligned scales. For matrices that read from the residual stream, such as WQ, WK, WV, Win, and Wgate, scales are assigned per row. For matrices that write back to the residual stream, such as WO and Wout, scales are assigned per column. The motivation is to separate each functional vector’s magnitude from the direction represented by its quantized codes, instead of tying unrelated functional units through a conventional per-output-channel or per-input-channel layout. RoleQ-T builds a ternary conversion pipeline around this format: a data-free learned rotation chooses a better basis, ternary GPTQ is adapted to role-aligned scales with an exact per-vector step, and a short scale-distillation stage updates scales while keeping ternary codes frozen. For slightly larger budgets, a sparse second ternary plane is added to selected units. Selection is based on per-unit Fisher saliency rather than raw quantization error, so extra bits are allocated to errors that are more likely to affect loss.","experiments":"$1d4","reading_guide":"A 30-minute skim is enough for most readers. In MLA, the cache stores a shared content latent rather than separate keys and values. That latent is later projected into both content keys and values for every head. As a result, one quantization error perturbs both attention matching and value readout at the same time. Most prior KV-cache quantization methods were designed for standard MHA/GQA with separate K/V caches, so they do not model this shared-error coupling.
