language models: long-term memory and reasoning are stored in the same parameter set. Increasing knowledge capacity usually means scaling the whole backbone or continuing to train all parameters, which is expensive and can cause forgetting or unintended capability shifts. Memory Decoder separates long-term memory into a pretrained, swappable parametric module. This work tests whether that idea still works at a more realistic pretraining scale: up to 6.9B memory parameters and 300B training tokens.","importance":"The main value for pretraining research is the parameter-allocation result. The paper provides evidence that, under a comparable parameter budget, assigning parameters to an independently trained memory can be more efficient than putting all additional parameters into the backbone. This has direct implications for continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and modular language models. Domain knowledge can be trained as a separate memory and swapped at inference while the base model remains frozen. The contribution is not only architectural; it also shows how to build the kNN teacher distributions at 207B-token scale. A caveat is that the memory is trained from a non-parametric kNN teacher, so the offline indexing and search cost is substantial. The result should be read as a credible path for decoupling knowledge capacity from reasoning capacity, not as a cost-free replacement for backbone scaling.","technical_approach":"The method combines a frozen base LM with a separately pretrained parametric memory. At inference, both modules process the same context and produce next-token distributions. The final prediction is an interpolation: p_final = (1 - alpha) p_theta + alpha p_mem. The memory is trained to imitate a kNN-LM distribution while retaining a standard next-token objective. The loss shown in the paper is beta KL + (1 - beta) CE: the KL term aligns the memory with the non-parametric retriever distribution, and the CE term preserves direct language-modeling supervision. Compared with RAG, the approach does not retrieve external passages at inference. Compared with kNN-LM, it compresses the retrieval distribution into parameters. The scaling work is enabled by a distributed Faiss pipeline with embedding compression, index sharding, and parallel search. For general memory pretraining, sparse kNN distribution storage and distributed streaming are used so that each batch only loads the required distribution entries.","experiments":"The largest general memory has 6.9B parameters and is pretrained on 300B tokens. benchmark”，而是一个更难也更接近生产的问题：怎样持续地产生高质量、会适应目标模型变化、能覆盖新攻击面的对抗样本，用来训练和评估前沿模型在 prompt injection 等 agentic 风险下的鲁棒性。作者指出，静态红队数据集规模有限，模型很容易记住已有攻击模板，却仍然对会试探、会迭代、会针对具体系统弱点调整策略的攻击者失守。论文因此把红队数据生成本身做成一个可训练对象：训练一个自动化 attacker，在与 defender 的反复交互中学会发现有效失败案例，再把这些失败样本回流到 defender 的 RL 训练里，形成持续升级的攻防闭环。","importance":"对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“安全红队”从一次性评测资产变成了可扩展的训练信号生成器，这和预训练里用更强数据生成器提升数据质量的思路是同构的，只是这里生成的是 adversarial post-training data。第二，它展示了一个很清楚的 flywheel：更强 attacker 产出更难样本，更强 defender 逼 attacker 学新策略，训练信号不再停留在固定分布上。对于 pretrain↔posttrain 接口，这很重要，因为它说明后训练阶段也可以像预训练一样依赖持续扩展的数据分布，而不是只靠人工标注集。第三，论文给出了一个少见的信号：OpenAI 明确把这类训练规模拉到“大型 RL post-training run”级别，并把 GPT-Red 直接用于 GPT-5.2 之后各代生产模型的训练与评估。这意味着在前沿模型体系里，鲁棒性数据生成已经被当成一条独立、重投入的训练管线，而不是附属评测工具。","technical_approach":"方法上有三个关键设计。第一是 agentic red-teaming harness。作者不是让 attacker 一次性吐出一个攻击 prompt，而是给它一个有状态的 defender_model 工具，让它像人工红队一样多轮试探、观察反馈、再改写攻击。这样做的原因很直接：prompt injection 往往依赖上下文、工具调用、文件局部编辑、系统提示泄露等交互细节，单步生成很难覆盖真实攻击过程。第二是环境构造。论文把已有 capability tasks 改写成 adversarial RL environments，在 defender 执行原任务时，允许 attacker 在指定位置插入或修改内容，例如篡改一次工具返回、编辑本地文件某个区域、污染外部文档片段等。这样定义 threat model 有两个好处：一是攻击面贴近真实 agent 系统；二是环境可以随着生产任务域扩展而自然扩展，不需要每次从零手写安全任务。第三是大规模 self-play RL。基础博弈是 attacker 成功诱发有效失败就得奖励，defender 成功抵抗并完成原任务就得奖励。但作者没有停留在单一 attacker-vs-defender 对局，而是把 attacker 放到一个同时训练的 defender population 上。这样做是为了避免 attacker 过拟合某个 defender 的怪癖，转而学习“如何快速识别不同模型的薄弱点”。从训练动力学看，这更像 population-based adversarial training，而不是普通的两人零和游戏。论文还强调三种 scaling 轴：测试时算力，通过 agentic harness 允许更长搜索与迭代；环境多样性，通过广泛的红队场景和攻击目标；训练算力，通过接近顶级 RL run 的规模把策略真正训出来。最终得到的 GPT-Red 不是一个固定模板库，而是一个会搜索、会适应、会迁移的攻击代理。","experiments":"实验结论很集中：GPT-Red 在已知模型、未知目标、未知环境上都能找到更多有效攻击，而且会随着 test-time compute 增加继续变强。论文给出的代表性结果包括：1）它能够稳定攻破此前各代 GPT-5 系列模型，直到 GPT-5.5；2）在 2025 IPI Challenge 这类与训练环境不同的 prompt injection 场景中，GPT-Red 找到的有效攻击数超过人类红队和 GPT-5.5 baseline；3）它能迁移到真实系统，例如文中展示的 AI vending machine 场景；4）作者把过去六个月逐步增强的红队模型持续接入生产模型训练，从 GPT-5.2 开始一路用于后续版本，最终 GPT-5.6 在广泛鲁棒性评测上达到当前最高水平。虽然公开文本里没有完整披露每个训练 run 的参数量、token 数、RL step 数和全部绝对指标，但有几个实验信号很关键：一是 test-time scaling 明显成立，说明 attacker 的能力不只是参数记忆，而是搜索与策略改进能力；二是 defender population 训练带来更强泛化，说明多对手训练确实缓解了对单一目标的过拟合；三是 out-of-distribution transfer 成立，说明学到的不是单一 prompt 模板，而是更抽象的攻击策略。对做训练的人来说，这些比单个 benchmark 分数更有信息量。","reading_guide":"建议先看 Introduction 和 Vision 部分，抓住论文真正提出的对象：不是一个评测器，而是一条自动生成 adversarial training data 的训练管线。然后重点看 Section 3.2 的 threat model 和环境定义，理解 attacker 到底能改什么、不能改什么；这一部分决定了训练信号是否真实。接着看 Section 4 的 agentic harness，关注为什么要给 attacker 状态和工具，以及它如何利用交互式搜索。Section 5 是核心，重点看 self-play 如何扩展到 defender Static red-teaming datasets are small, quickly exhausted, and easy for defenders to overfit to. What is missing is a scalable attacker that can adapt to a target model, iterate through interaction, and keep discovering fresh prompt-injection failures as the defender improves. GPT-Red is proposed as that attacker: an automated red-teaming agent trained through self-play so that adversarial examples become a renewable training signal rather than a fixed corpus.","importance":"Its relevance to foundation-model research is broader than safety benchmarking. VLM pretraining (especially continued pretraining) data mixture pipelines lack a principled, reproducible framework. Open-source practices rely on heuristic quality filtering, brute-force dataset stacking, and intuition-driven cross-domain ratio setting, with two critical flaws: first, pipelines focus only on noise removal without systematic assessment of data difficulty and diversity; second, inter-class (across capability categories) and intra-class (within a single category) ratio optimization are not decoupled, making high-dimensional joint search intractable and the impact of new dataset additions un-attributable. Frontier proprietary recipes remain undisclosed, blocking iterative improvement of open data pipelines.","importance":"This work formalizes VLM data mixture construction from an empirical craft into a reproducible engineering discipline. The decoupled inter/intra-class optimization paradigm directly transfers to pure-text LLM and unified multimodal pretraining data mixing scenarios. multimodal pre-training from scratch. Given a fixed budget, it asks how to choose model size, token count, and the text-versus-multimodal data ratio. This is different from the dominant late-fusion VLM pipeline, where a pretrained LLM and a pretrained vision encoder are connected by a projection module and then continued on multimodal data. Late fusion is efficient, but it inherits an optimization asymmetry: language and vision representations are learned under different objectives and distributions. The paper asks whether a single Transformer trained from scratch on mixed multimodal inputs follows compute-optimal scaling laws, and whether the optimal allocation for language and multimodal objectives is aligned or in conflict.","importance":"The contribution is mainly a scaling framework for native multimodal pre-training, not another fixed VLM recipe. It provides evidence that the attainable loss of native multimodal training follows predictable compute laws, so the regime can be studied with the same discipline as text-only pre-training. The important finding is that language and multimodal objectives have different allocation behavior. The language allocation law is relatively invariant to data composition, while the multimodal allocation law is sensitive to the multimodal data ratio. This matters for real pre-training runs: a text-heavy mixture may be compute-efficient only at larger model sizes, and the right mixture depends on the target point on the language-multimodal Pareto frontier.","technical_approach":"The paper formulates pre-training loss as L(N,D) under the standard compute approximation C=6ND, where N is the number of active non-embedding parameters and D is the number of training tokens. It then estimates compute-optimal model size N_opt(C) and token count D_opt(C). The analysis is done separately for the text objective L_text and the multimodal objective L_mm, rather than collapsing everything into a single aggregate loss. Two estimators are used. IsoFLOP profiles compare different model/data allocations at the same compute level and identify the best allocation directly. Training-curve envelopes estimate the minimum achievable loss from the envelope of training trajectories. Their agreement is an important sanity check: the result is less likely to be an artifact of a chosen parametric fit. The paper further introduces the multimodal data ratio r and models how r changes both the compute law and the allocation exponents.","experiments":"The experiments vary model size, training tokens, and multimodal data ratio for Transformer-based native multimodal models trained from scratch. Smoothed training loss is used as the common proxy because robust multimodal validation metrics are not yet standardized and each token is approximately seen once during pre-training. The main empirical result is that both text and multimodal losses obey stable compute laws, while compute-optimal N and D follow power-law allocation rules. Data-mixture studies show that the text allocation law is fairly stable across mixtures, whereas the multimodal allocation law shifts substantially with the multimodal ratio. Downstream evaluations add two useful checks: native multimodal pre-training improves pure-text spatial reasoning, and the resulting models show multimodal in-context learning behavior. models use different tokenizers. Standard OPD queries the teacher on student-generated trajectories and matches the teacher’s next-token distribution, but it assumes aligned token positions and a shared vocabulary. That assumption breaks for heterogeneous model families such as Qwen, GLM, and MiniMax. Existing cross-tokenizer methods either drop unmatched teacher probability mass, assign mass by rank rather than byte content, or avoid dense token-level supervision altogether. The target problem is to build a teacher distribution over the student vocabulary that is complete, byte-aligned, and mass-preserving.","importance":"The work is practically relevant for consolidating capabilities from multiple open-weight model families into a compact student without being constrained by tokenizer compatibility. This is useful for thinking about RL pre-training, continual learning, and synthetic data scaling. Historical trajectories alone are too verbose to serve as a stable generator memory, and passive filters only reject bad samples after generation. Skill-SP instead uses skills as an active interface for generation, verification, and curriculum control.","technical_approach":"Skill-SP consists of a Proposer, a Solver, a Controller, and an evolving skill library. The Proposer generates challenges conditioned on routed skill packages. The Solver attempts the tasks and is trained through reinforcement learning. The Controller analyzes execution traces and updates the skill library. A skill package is a modular unit of procedural knowledge. It may contain task instructions, supporting resources, structural constraints, executable verification logic, and historical difficulty statistics. This makes it more than a prompt template: it is a control surface for the self-play loop. The Controller can refine existing skills, archive obsolete ones, and induce new skills from open-ended exploration. Compared with unguided self-play, Skill-SP adds explicit routing, skill evolution, and difficulty tracking. The paper also notes that unguided self-play fails to synthesize valid puzzles in the logical-reasoning setting, so it is absent from that comparison. 的绝对大小统一裁剪或屏蔽 token，默认“大 ratio 就不可信”。作者指出这个前提在异步 agentic RL 里并不成立，因为 ratio 的自然尺度随 token entropy 系统变化。低熵位置的大 ratio 往往只是近零概率放大的采样噪声，高熵位置的大 ratio 反而可能是异步更新带来的真实探索信号。核心问题因此变成：如何在不重建精确行为策略的情况下，区分应当抑制的 区域。若这个问题处理不好，吞吐提升会被训练崩溃抵消。对 pretrain 研究者而言，启发在两层。第一，它揭示了 token-level 训练信号的尺度不是常数，而与分布熵相关，这和预训练里 loss spike、难度分布、confidence calibration 的分析是相通的。第二，它说明异步系统设计不能只看系统吞吐，必须把优化目标里的统计失真一并建模。贡献量级上，这属于“机制解释 + log-importance-ratio 或 ratio 偏移量的自然尺度会随 token entropy 增长。直观上，若一个 token 处于低熵、模型极其自信的区域，行为策略和目标策略之间哪怕只有很小的 train-inference gap，也会因为某些近零概率项而被放大成很大的 ratio；这种大值并不一定对应真实策略漂移，而更像数值上被放大的采样噪声。相反，在高熵区域，策略本来就不确定，较大的 ratio 更可能落在合理波动范围内。第二步，作者分析异步 RL 的 staleness 结构，不再把一条轨迹视为来自单一行为策略，而是拆成 inter-trajectory staleness 和 intra-trajectory version Trust Region。它不是用固定阈值判断 |δ_t| 是否过大，而是让每个 token 的允许边界随其熵自适应伸缩：低熵 token 采用更紧的 trust region，避免噪声放大进入梯度；高熵 token 采用更宽的 trust region，保留真实探索。论文强调 ESTR 不需要显式重建行为策略，也不依赖人为 magnitude bias。实现上，它是 token-level when normalized networks are trained with strong weight decay. Prior explanations mostly emphasize learning-rate criticality, where the effective step size crosses a stability boundary. The paper adds a separate mechanism: weight-norm criticality. Normalization creates scale-invariant parameter blocks. Weight decay keeps shrinking their norms. As those norms approach zero, the local Hessian can grow rapidly even though the loss is insensitive to rescaling, and the optimizer can be pushed into an unstable regime.","importance":"The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. Modern LLMs routinely combine LayerNorm or RMSNorm with decoupled weight decay, and loss spikes are often attributed to data batches, large learning rates, Adam dynamics, or global sharpness. This work shows that a particular normalized component can become unstable because its norm collapses, even when a global learning-rate story is incomplete. The contribution is not a new recipe, but a mechanism and a monitoring framework: stability can be checked at the level of scale-invariant blocks rather than only at the full-model level. It also clarifies why weight decay has a practical upper limit in normalized architectures: stronger regularization can improve generalization, but it can also move certain components past a norm-dependent critical boundary.","technical_approach":"$963","experiments":"The empirical evidence spans several settings. A LLaMA-style Transformer is pretrained for one epoch on a 100B-token corpus while sweeping only the weight decay coefficient over {0, 0.5, 1}; stronger decay produces clear training-loss spikes. To show the effect is not specific to autoregressive language modeling, the authors train ResNet-50 on CIFAR-100 with SGD and again vary only weight decay, observing the same phenomenon in normalized networks. A controlled MNIST fully connected network then separates the factors by using BN, LN, or Identity in hidden blocks. The results indicate that neither normalization nor weight decay alone explains the spikes; the interaction is the driver. A synthetic regression setup further reproduces the chain from weight-norm shrinkage to Hessian growth and instability. The key ablation insight is that increasing decay shrinks normalization-related weight norms, raises sharpness, and makes the component-wise criticality indicator predictive of spikes.","reading_guide":"Read the Introduction and empirical sections first to understand the distinction from the standard Edge-of-Stability account. state，很有参考价值。","technical_approach":"方法上，LISA把原来的 self-attention 替换成并联的两条支路。第一条是 linear attention，用一个递推状态矩阵 S_t 累积历史 K/V 信息，承担全局长程记忆。它的优点是每步更新和读取都不随序列长度增长，时间近似 O(1)，内存也是常数级；缺点是缺少 softmax attention 那种基于内容的精确索引能力。第二条是 Lightning Indexer，对历史 token 做重要性打分，从中动态选出 top-M 个 token，保留一个固定大小的精确 self-attention 视野。这样，模型既能通过线性状态保留“全局背景”，又能对少量关键 token 做高保真回看。\n\n关键不在于简单拼接两种注意力，而在于训练方式。论文采用两阶段训练。第一阶段先只训练 linear attention 分支，用纯 cross-entropy 冷启动，让线性状态先学会承接原模型的基本语言建模与推理分布。作者强调不用一开始就做 teacher KL，是为了避免线性分支过早过拟合教师分布表面形态，学不到自己的稳定记忆表示。第二阶段再引入 indexer 和 top-M 选择，同时加入 KL 蒸馏，稳定重要 token 的选择和整体输出分布。这里的直觉是：索引器一旦参与，离散 attention，后者虽然便宜，但在需要精确定位某一步中间结果、变量定义或约束条件时容易失败；LISA用固定预算的 full attention 弥补这一点。它还不同于需要特殊数据预处理的 state compression 方法，接入路径更接近模块替换 + 轻量训练，工程上更现实。","experiments":"实验主要围绕长上下文数学推理展开，覆盖五个 的多个 domain specialist，不通过额外蒸馏或梯度更新，直接在固定 base 谱的前提下把各专家的 frame 变化合并成一个单一 checkpoint，能恢复互补能力；ISO-Optimizer（在线）：在 RLVR 训练过程中把参数化约束在 base 谱对应的固定谱流形上，允许 frame 自由更新，可以搭配 AdamW/Muon 等现有 base optimizer Elo 等变量控制；然后在 synthetic reasoning traces 上做 SFT，使模型具备可用于 RL 初始化的推理轨迹格式；最后用 verifiable reward 做 RL。这个设置对应 LLM 的 base model、SFT model、RL-tuned model，但比自然语言更容易归因。第二层是联合 scaling law。作者先拟合 Chinchilla 风格的预训练 loss scaling，建模参数量 N、预训练 token 数 T 与 loss 的关系；再观察 RL 阶段中 downstream pass@1 的提升斜率如何随预训练条件变化。关键发现是 post-RL 性能可以由 pretraining loss 提供强预测信号，而局部 RL 改善率与 log T 近似线性相关。这样就可以对由 N、T、RL compute 组成的训练 recipe 打分，并画出 compute-optimal frontier。第三层是机制分析。作者不只看最终解题正确率，而是检查单步 move policy 的变化。结果显示，在简单 puzzle 上，RL 更多是在放大 SFT policy 已经偏好的正确 move；在困难 puzzle 上，RL 有时能把原先概率很低但正确的 move 推上来。这解释了为什么“RL 只是 sharpening”和“RL 能组合新能力”两种说法都会在不同难度区间出现。","experiments":"核心实验覆盖 5M 到 1B 参数模型，并扫了 36 组 pretraining-RL 组合。评估指标包括 pass@1，以及围绕 policy evolution 的逐步行为分析。主要结果有三点。第一，预训练 loss 对 RL 后下游性能有预测力，说明 base prior addresses a concrete checkpoint-migration problem: a model has already been pretrained, but its tokenizer no longer matches the deployment language mix. The original LFM2 tokenizer is compact and efficient for English, code, and a fixed set of languages, but it fragments languages such as Hindi, Vietnamese, and Thai into many more tokens. That directly increases decoding steps. For on-device models, increasing the vocabulary is not free, because the embedding and LM-head matrices affect memory footprint and per-token decode bandwidth. The problem is therefore how to expand the tokenizer in place, improve multilingual compression, and preserve the accumulated quality of the pretrained checkpoint without restarting pretraining.","importance":"The main value is a production-scale recipe for tokenizer evolution after pretraining. This is directly relevant to foundation-model maintenance, especially when deployment priorities change after the original pretraining run. No prior work has verified the feasibility of poisoning heterogeneous web-scale corpora (e.g., Common Crawl), nor analyzed whether malicious content can survive modern data crawling, extraction, and quality filtering pipelines to enter final training sets.","importance":"The work identifies third-party content injection (via public discussion interfaces and similar open participation features) as a practical attack surface for pretraining data poisoning, filling the gap in feasibility studies for web-scale corpus poisoning. It has direct implications for pretraining data security and data pipeline design. The proposed HalfLife analysis framework provides a reusable tool for evaluating the risk of various content injection vectors reaching pretraining corpora.","technical_approach":"First, it defines a new threat model of third-party content injection attacks, where an adversary has no access to the model training pipeline, and instead injects malicious text into non-owned webpages via public discussion interfaces, relying on ordinary web crawlers to pick up the content and include it in pretraining corpora. Second, it introduces the HalfLife analysis framework, which measures retention rates of injected content across three pipeline stages (web crawling, text extraction, quality filtering) and multiplies them to get the final inclusion probability. Third, it compares the viability of two injection vectors: public comments (via computational propaganda-style automated posting) and programmatic ads. token 处接收该状态。两者之间通过一个 gated fusion 模块连接，门控负责控制当前 token 本地表示与前一 token 持续状态的混合比例。这个设计和简单 residual addition 的区别在于，它允许模型按上下文动态决定何时依赖跨时间潜变量，何时主要依赖当前 token 的标准前向计算。\n\n训练上的难点比结构本身更重要。严格的时间递归会让 teacher forcing 下不同位置之间产生真实依赖，从而破坏标准并行训练。作者提出 approximate temporal-parallel training 来恢复可扩展性：训练时对递归路径做近似并行化处理，使得序列维度仍可并行，而不是像 RNN 那样完全串行。论文把这一点作为可预训练性的关键，因为如果没有这一步，架构即使概念上成立，也很难在大规模语料上训练。这里值得注意的是，它不是完全精确地复现推理时的递归，而是在训练可扩展性和递归保真度之间做了工程折中。\n\n和相关方法相比，差异很明确。相对 latent-recurrent methods，它把状态放在中层而不是输入端；相对 depth-looping repeatedly compressed back into token space at every decoding step, so abstract reasoning states do not persist well across time. Prior latent-reasoning approaches usually pass recurrent information through embeddings or final-layer outputs, which is a poor match to the empirical observation that abstract reasoning is concentrated in middle layers. Depth-looping alternatives increase per-token compute by reusing layers multiple times, but their inference cost grows with the number of loops. T^2MLR asks whether a Transformer can preserve and evolve latent reasoning states directly in the middle of the network, while keeping standard teacher-forced pretraining and near-standard decoding cost.","importance":"Its value for pretraining research is threefold. 时一个长期被简化掉的关键问题：生成轨迹的策略不只包含“在 masked 位置填什么 token”，还包含“这一步哪些位置保留、哪些位置 remask”，也就是 unmasking order 本身。现有 RL 方法大多只优化 token 部分的近似对数概率，把位置选择当成固定过程或隐含过程处理，导致 policy gradient 不完整。论文要做的是把 MDLM 生成正式写成一个两阶段动作 MDP，并把 masking decision 也纳入可优化策略。","importance":"对新型语言建模范式尤其是 diffusion LM 很重要，因为它补上了一个从预训练目标到 post-train RL 的接口问题。AR 模型能直接做 policy gradient，原因是轨迹 likelihood 可分解且易算；MDLM 一直缺少同样干净的 RL 形式化，这限制了它在 reasoning/coding 上继续吃到 RL 红利。这里的贡献不只是“又一个 RL trick”，而是指出 MDLM 的策略空间天然比 AR 更丰富，顺序控制本身就是可学习决策，而不是采样细节。这个视角如果成立，会影响后续对 diffusion LM 的训练目标、采样器设计、以及 pretrain-posttrain 一体化理解。量级上，它属于 diffusion LM 走向可竞争 MDP，于是整条轨迹的概率自然分解为 token policy 与 masking policy 的乘积，对应的 policy gradient 也分解成两项：一个奖励好的 token 预测，一个奖励好的位置/顺序选择。\n\n关键点在于 masking term 不是额外训练一个策略头。作者从模型已有 logits 中构造 unmasking scores，再通过 softmax 得到位置选择的对数概率，因此不需要额外参数，也不需要额外 forward pass。这一点很重要，因为 diffusion LM 本来采样链就比 AR 长，如果再加独立 masking network，训练和推理都会更重。\n\n从理论上，论文证明忽略 masking term 会漏掉能提升期望回报的梯度方向。直观上也成立：在 MDLM 里，先揭示哪些位置、把哪些不确定位置留到后面，本身就会影响后续条件分布和最终答案质量。只奖励 token 而不奖励顺序，相当于把一半策略空间冻结了。\n\n算法兼容性也是一个优点。作者不是重新发明一套 RL 框架，而是把这个分解嵌入标准 policy gradient family 中。也就是说，任何原本依赖 log-prob 的 RL 算法，只要能处理 trajectory-level reward，就可以把 token log-prob 和 mask log-prob 一起纳入目标。对于 diffusion LM 社区，这比设计一个专用优化器更有推广性。\n\n和已有方法相比，差异主要有三点。相对 ELBO-based RL 近似，它不再把训练目标停留在 token reconstruction 视角，而是显式建模生成轨迹。相对只用 trajectory token likelihood 的方法，它把 unmasking order 也当作 policy。相对需要额外网络预测顺序的方案，它直接复用模型 logits，工程代价更低。","experiments":"论文的实验重点在数学推理和代码生成，结论比较集中：联合优化 token term 和 masking term，稳定优于只优化 token 的现有方法。摘要里给出的代表性提升是 MATH500 最多 +4.0%，HumanEval +2.9%，GSM8K 和 MBPP 各 +2.5%。同时，论文声称达到这些任务上的当前最好结果之一，说明收益不是只在单一数据集上出现。\n\n更值得看的其实是消融。核心消融应当包括：只保留 token gradient、只保留 masking gradient、两者同时优化；不同 remasking/unmasking schedule 下 masking term 的贡献；以及 position log-prob 的不同构造方式。这里如果两项联合始终最好，就说明 masking policy 不是噪声正则，而是真正提供了额外可学习信号。\n\n从方法描述推断，论文还会比较与 ELBO 近似 RL、trajectory-based token-only RL 的差异。要重点看这些对照是否控制了 rollout 数、采样步数、reward likelihood”，这意味着性能提升不是靠更大训练预算换来的，而是更完整地利用了同一条生成轨迹中的监督信号。如果正文里给出 wall-clock 或 sample efficiency，对判断实际价值会更有帮助。","reading_guide":"先看问题形式化，不要急着看结果表。最关键的是把 MDLM 的一步生成理解成“token prediction + remasking 分钟足够。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper isolates a specific failure mode of low-precision training: learning can stop not because gradients vanish or optimization diverges, but because individual parameter updates become smaller than half an ULP of the stored weight and are rounded away. Those coordinates then become permanently immobile even while their gradients remain nonzero. The central problem is to characterize this “silent freeze” as a deterministic arithmetic phenomenon, and to predict when it happens from a high-precision trajectory plus the target mantissa length, without running the low-precision training itself.","importance":"This matters for pretraining because it identifies a failure mode that standard training dashboards can easily miss. Loss may look smooth and training may appear stable, while a large fraction of parameters has already stopped moving. The work ties continued learnability to a single scale ratio involving weight magnitude, gradient magnitude, learning rate, and mantissa precision. That is directly relevant to bf16, fp8, and aggressively quantized training recipes. absolute embedding，它仍然是相对位置编码，因而不会丢掉 RoPE 在长度泛化和 attention 结构上的优点。相比 partial RoPE，它不是手工决定哪些低频带不旋转，而是让优化过程自己决定哪些频带应更慢、近似不旋转，哪些频带应承担更强的位置变化。相比单纯调大 base，它不是对整个频谱做统一缩放，而是允许非均匀重排频率谱。论文分析部分显示，模型最终学出的频率 if the large-model results hold, GIFT is a rare low-intrusion fix for low-precision gradient communication."},"summary":{"core_problem":"分布式 LLM 预训练中，梯度通信占整体训练时间的比例可达 40%（128 卡 A100 训练 8.3B 模型场景）。使用 FP8 等低精度格式压缩梯度是直接的带宽优化手段，但现有方法在欧氏空间中做线性/非线性量化，会因梯度分布的高度各向异性（不同方向的方差差异大）引入方向相关的失真，导致同步后的更新方向偏离高精度基准，最终损害下游任务性能。同时，多数已有工作同时量化权重、激活、优化器状态，难以单独评估低精度梯度本身的影响，也难以平衡额外计算开销与通信收益。","importance":"这是首个从黎曼几何视角系统诊断低精度梯度量化误差来源的工作，明确指出欧氏空间均匀缩放与各向异性梯度几何之间的不匹配是性能下降的核心原因。方法层面提供了一种不修改优化器、模型结构、训练配方、通信原语和数值格式的纯坐标变换方案，可直接对接 NCCL 2.24 原生 FP8 通信，工程侵入性极低。实践层面给出了“选择性几何变换”的成本-收益折中思路，让 K-FAC 类近似的额外计算开销可被通信收益覆盖，为大规模预训练中 FP8 梯度通信的落地提供了可复现的路径。","technical_approach":"核心思路是在量化前将梯度变换到近似各向同性的坐标系，使 FP8 均匀缩放对不同维度引入的误差量级相当。具体实现分三步：1）误差诊断：通过 Fisher 信息矩阵白化将梯度映射到黎曼流形，验证该空间下梯度分布接近各向同性，量化误差显著低于欧氏空间；2）几何近似：采用 K-FAC 对 Fisher 矩阵做 Kronecker 分解近似，仅用于构造临时通信坐标系，不替换优化器的更新规则（仍使用 Muon 优化器的原生更新）；3）选择性应用：先逐层评估量化敏感度，仅对量化误差敏感的层执行 K-FAC 变换与逆变换，其余层沿用标准逐层欧氏缩放，控制额外计算量。整个流程只改变梯度通信时的坐标表示，不影响优化器状态存储和模型权重精度。","experiments":"基于 Megatron-LM 实现，在 OpenWebText 数据集上预训练 Llama-300M 和 Llama-600M，优化器采用 Muon。误差分析显示，与欧氏逐层缩放的 FP8 基线相比，GIFT 将 FP8 梯度与 FP32 梯度的平均误差降低最多 67.4%。通信体积方面，相对 FP32 梯度减少 75%（对应 FP8 的理论压缩比）。端到端训练速度上，64 张 GH200 超芯片场景下，整体预训练时间较 FP32 减少 7.6%；同规模下直接使用欧氏 FP8 可减少 10.79% 的时间，GIFT 以约 3 个百分点的原始加速比为代价，换来了更好的下游任务性能保留。下游评估中，相同优化器和通信路径下，GIFT 预训练的模型在多数任务上的表现优于欧氏 FP8 基线，更接近 BF16/FP32 基准。","reading_guide":"重点阅读第 II 节的误差诊断部分，尤其是梯度各向异性与欧氏量化误差的对应关系推导，以及 Fisher 白化后分布变化的可视化；其次关注选择性 K-FAC 变换的敏感度评估标准和层选择策略，这是控制计算开销的关键；实验部分重点对比 GIFT、欧氏 FP8、FP32 三者的梯度误差-训练时间-下游性能三维权衡，注意区分“通信体积减少”和“端到端加速比”的差异。值得深挖的点包括：该几何变换思路是否可扩展到 NVFP4 等更低精度格式、是否可与 ZeRO 等分片数据并行策略结合、量化敏感度评估是否可在训练前离线完成以进一步降低开销。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"In distributed LLM pretraining, gradient communication can account for up to 40% of total training time (as observed in a 128-A100 setup for an 8.3B GPT-style model). Compressing gradients into low-precision formats such as FP8 directly cuts bandwidth usage, but existing methods perform linear or nonlinear quantization in Euclidean space. Because gradient distributions are highly anisotropic—variances differ drastically across directions—uniform scaling introduces direction-dependent distortion that drifts the synchronized update away from the high-precision reference, degrading downstream performance. Most prior works simultaneously quantize weights, activations, and optimizer states, making it hard to isolate the impact of low-precision gradients alone, or to balance extra compute overhead against communication savings.","importance":"This work provides the first systematic diagnosis of low-precision gradient quantization error from a Riemannian geometry perspective, identifying the mismatch between anisotropic local gradient geometry and axis-aligned Euclidean scaling as the root cause of performance degradation. The proposed solution is a pure coordinate transformation that leaves the optimizer, model architecture, training recipe, communication collectives, and numerical format untouched, enabling direct integration with NCCL 2.24 native FP8 communication with minimal engineering overhead. The selective geometry-transform strategy further makes K-FAC-style approximation practical, such that the extra compute cost is offset by communication gains. It offers a reproducible path for deploying FP8 gradient communication in large-scale pretraining.","technical_approach":"$9bb","experiments":"Implemented in Megatron-LM. Error analysis shows GIFT reduces the average difference between FP8 and FP32 gradients by up to 67.4% compared with a Euclidean layer-wise scaling FP8 baseline. This paper shows that, given the same base model, optimizer, and token budget, different online selectors—random, loss-based, quality-based, diversity-based, and similar—induce large and structured changes in model behavior before any preference optimization or RL is applied. These changes appear on axes normally associated with alignment: helpfulness, refusal behavior, verbosity, truthfulness, sycophancy, calibration, and jailbreak robustness. The paper studies online data selection as implicit alignment and asks how to measure, predict, and control that drift.","importance":"The work reframes a common post-training component. Data selection in SFT is not a neutral subsampling step; it acts as an implicit preference model that shapes behavior before DPO or RLHF begins. This matters for pretrain–posttrain interface research in three ways. First, online selection changes the starting distribution that later alignment steps see, so SFT data policy must be evaluated on behavioral axes rather than only loss or task accuracy. Second, quality- and loss-based filtering criteria are themselves training signals with directional effects, which has implications for mid-training filtering, annealing data mixtures, and pretraining data curation more broadly. Third, the proposed alignment-aware selection gives a practical recipe for preserving efficiency benefits while constraining undesirable behavioral drift.","technical_approach":"$9c7","experiments":"The experiments hold base model, optimizer, and selected-token budget fixed and vary only the selection policy. The main finding is that selectors can achieve similar task accuracy while producing substantial, structured, reproducible drift on alignment-relevant behavioral axes, and the direction of drift is predicted by which response attributes the selector over-represents. Qualitative patterns include: loss-based selection over-samples surprising cases, including ambiguous safety examples, unusual refusal formats, and long explanations, which shifts refusal behavior and jailbreak robustness; quality-based selection favors polished responses but increases verbosity, stylistic homogeneity, and overconfidence; diversity-based selection preserves topical coverage but still shifts the distribution of refusal language. In autoregressive decoding, each new token must read an ever-growing KV cache, so cost scales with context length while output remains one token per step. Two families of methods attack this from different sides: linear-time mixers such as Mamba reduce cache traffic, while block diffusion language models generate multiple tokens in parallel. The difficulty is that existing hybrid diffusion models, especially full-sequence bidirectional Mamba denoisers, rely on reverse scans whose states depend on the current noisy sequence. inference-time summarization is not optimized by the task reward. The goal is to train the model to execute the task and to generate the compacted state that later decisions will depend on.","importance":"This is a strong post-training method with clear implications for foundation-model training. It treats context compaction as a learned policy action rather than an external memory heuristic. The contribution matters because long-horizon ability does not have to come only from larger context windows; it can also come from trained state compression under a fixed context budget. It also exposes a training issue that is easy to miss: once a rollout is split by compaction, segment length, segment position, and delayed reward all affect the quality of the RL signal.","technical_approach":"The method is built on PPO. The choice is deliberate: group-relative methods such as GRPO assume groups of comparable complete rollouts, while compaction creates a variable number of segments per task. During rollout collection, when the remaining context budget falls below a threshold, the model receives a fixed summarization instruction and samples a summary using the current policy. The next context is reconstructed from that summary plus a short tail of recent interaction, and the agent continues the task. Both ordinary action tokens and summary tokens are optimized under the same final task reward. Two design choices carry most of the method. Token-level loss normalization reduces bias from segments or summaries with different lengths. Cross-trajectory GAE preserves temporal credit assignment across compaction boundaries, so that the final outcome can still assign credit or blame to summary tokens generated much earlier.","experiments":"The reported experiments focus on long-horizon agentic coding. On GLM-4.5-Air, the gains are 7.0 and 3.1 points on the same two benchmarks. These numbers indicate that training the compaction behavior is better than adding summarization only at inference time. The setup is also realistic for agent RL: the summary has no separate supervision, and its usefulness is learned through sparse task-level reward.","reading_guide":"Read carefully. 的空间没有想象中大，真正扩展信息源往往更重要。","technical_approach":"作者把合成数据 pipeline 表示为三元组 (Q, T, p)：Q 是 seed-question set，T 是 teacher，p 是合成协议，包括 prompt 模板、解码参数、过滤、选择、改写等。Source Expansion 改变 Q 或 T；Fixed-Source Synthesis 固定 (Q, T)，只改变每题生成预算 r 或协议 p。核心实验使用 rejection sampling：对每个 seed question 生成多个候选 response，经过过滤后形成 SFT 数据。论文把 rectified scaling law 改写到 FSS 场景，出发点是固定源上的重复采样会逐渐覆盖可获得的有效样本空间，因此曲线应当有上限，边际收益随 r The authors take a synthetic-data route at unusual scale. critic 结构与当前RLHF的无显式off-policy校正设定：1. 行为策略感知的GRPO代理目标重构：不同于默认行为策略与当前学习策略等价的传统GRPO推导，显式将生成rollout的陈旧行为策略φ与学习器参数θ解耦，定义代理梯度映射ℋ(θ,φ)，避免将代理梯度与分布依赖的总体目标全导数混为一谈，为滞后偏差分析提供了严谨基础。2. ELF 尺度、不同采样器和不同 churn/feedback 设置，发现重复越重，Gen-PPL 往往越低；去掉重复片段后，模型排序会反转，小模型之所以看起来最好，主要是因为它最会重复。第二步是机制分析。作者把 self-conditioning 看成一个离散时间反馈系统：当前步的 denoiser 输出 clean estimate，下一步又把这个 estimate self-conditioning 输入上减去一个固定方向 d。这个方向通过无监督方式估计：收集高重复轨迹和低重复轨迹的反馈表示，取两组均值之差作为 attractor direction。作者还推导了一个 closed-form 的可用强度窗口，避免 steering 过强把正常语义也抹掉。关键点在于干预位置选在 latent feedback，而不是 token decode 端；论文的论证是，重复在 argmax readout 之前就已经在连续空间里形成，decode-time penalty 只能处理后果，碰不到成因。方法上这和常见 repetition penalty、n-gram blocking、temperature 调节都不同，也不同于重新训练一个 anti-repetition is hidden by the field’s preferred metric. These models can generate heavily repetitive text, yet generative perplexity (Gen-PPL) often improves when repetition gets worse, because the external AR scorer assigns high probability to repeated sequences. The authors go beyond symptom-level observation and locate the mechanism in the self-conditioning loop itself. Each denoising step feeds its previous clean estimate back into the next step, creating a contractive dynamical system. In ELF-like models, this system develops an effectively one-dimensional attractor: once a trajectory aligns with that direction, it is pulled toward highly self-predictable, repetitive states. So the paper is solving two linked problems: metric mismeasurement and a structural inference-time degeneration in continuous DLMs.","importance":"This matters for pretraining research in a fairly direct way. First, it weakens the practice of treating Gen-PPL as a reliable headline metric for continuous diffusion or flow-based LMs. A lower score may simply mean stronger repetition, not better language modeling. That changes how one should compare non-AR models against AR baselines. Second, the paper turns a visible generation defect into a low-dimensional dynamical systems problem. That is useful beyond ELF, because many non-AR paradigms rely on iterative refinement and self-feedback. Third, it shows that the defect can be mitigated without retraining, by intervening on the feedback state rather than redesigning the whole model or objective. The contribution is less about building a stronger model and more about correcting the field’s understanding of what current results actually mean and how these models should be studies why GRPO training curves remain mostly empirical. Current practice often fits reward trajectories with simple exponential laws, but the fitted constants do not explain how learning rate, momentum, group size, KL anchoring, and refresh interval shape reward growth, saturation, variance, and instability. The paper derives a closed-form reduced-order model directly from the GRPO update.","importance":"The main value is a mechanistic view of RL post-training dynamics. The paper does not introduce a new optimizer; it turns GRPO training into a measurable dynamical system. This is useful for large-scale LLM training because it separates deterministic reward progress from sampling noise, explains why larger group size may reduce fluctuations without changing the mean trajectory, and gives stability predictions tied to optimizer settings and a measured curvature scale. For stability and oscillation predictions, the paper uses a controlled softmax-bandit reduction where the mean-field assumption holds exactly. This setting reproduces the overdamped-to-oscillatory transition and locates the refresh-interval threshold using an independently measured stiffness. The result matters for MoE pretraining because MoE layers reduce the compute-to-communication ratio, making pipeline parallelism more attractive again. Fixed one-step delay outperforms the original PipeDream schedule with variable delays, especially as pipeline depth grows. The scale validation trains a 10B-parameter MoE model for 200B tokens; with Muon, async PP, and Error Feedback, the final loss is identical to the synchronous baseline using the same hyperparameters. DLR does not enlarge the deployed low-rank model class. Instead, it changes the training dynamics while preserving the final inference graph. This is useful because many low-rank pre-training methods recover quality by adding sparse residuals, extra channels, latent gates, or mixing modules that must be served at inference time. DLR takes a cleaner deployment trade-off: add a fixed residual path during training, then fold it into the up-projection exactly. For pre-training researchers, the important point is the separation between training-time gradient shaping and inference-time architecture.","technical_approach":"DLR assumes a low-rank layer with a latent representation z and an output decoder B, producing Bz. During training, it adds a fixed structured residual, α/sqrt(K) · Expand_K(z), where K=ceil(d_out/r). Expand_K repeats each latent coordinate across output channels. In matrix form, this is α/sqrt(K) · R^T z for a fixed binary replication matrix R. The residual has no learnable parameters. Its training overhead is a repeat operation plus an addition. After training, the residual is folded into the decoder by setting B*=B+α/sqrt(K)·R^T, so the deployed layer is again a standard low-rank layer. The difference from sparse compensation or persistent auxiliary paths is that DLR adds no inference-time expressivity. Its benefit comes from changing the optimization path: the latent variables and the down-projection receive a deterministic output pathway that does not depend on the learned decoder B being well-conditioned early in training.","experiments":"The experiments cover four low-rank backbones: linear Low-Rank, CoLA, LOST, and LaX. In the single-seed 7B comparison, DLR+CoLA exceeds the reported LOST baseline after 40K steps while using 2.3x less per-GPU memory. Folded checkpoints also transfer to Alpaca-cleaned supervised fine-tuning; among the compared 1B checkpoints, DLR+CoLA gives a slightly higher average accuracy. memory updates can become poorly conditioned even when the recurrent form remains computationally efficient. The authors frame the issue as update geometry rather than only transition-matrix parameterization. Standard input-dependent SSM updates are largely first-order, rank-one injections, which can accumulate anisotropic spectra, weaken gradients, and overwrite existing memory.","importance":"The contribution is relevant to foundation-model pretraining because it addresses one of the main blockers for replacing or complementing attention with SSMs in long-context language models. MuonSSM imports the idea of orthogonalized, spectrally conditioned updates into the state dynamics themselves, not merely into the optimizer. This is a useful distinction: stable long-context modeling depends on the conditioning of the memory state, not just on parameter optimization. The method also preserves parallel scan structure, which keeps it in the design space of scalable sequence models.","technical_approach":"The paper first rewrites recent SSM variants as online associative memories. At each timestep, a memory matrix S_t receives a key-value pair (k_t, v_t), with scalar gates such as alpha_t and beta_t controlling retention and update magnitude. Under this view, models such as Mamba, DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, and LongHorn mainly differ in their gate choices, while their memory injection remains a first-order low-rank update. MuonSSM adds an auxiliary momentum matrix M_t that accumulates update directions over time, controlled by a decay gamma. It also applies a lightweight Newton-Schulz normalization to the low-rank injection X_t = tau beta_t v_t k_t^T. Since this rank-one matrix has a single nonzero singular value tau beta_t ||v_t|| ||k_t||, its scale can vary sharply across timesteps; the Newton-Schulz step bounds and conditions the injection without explicit SVD. The design keeps the recurrence affine after augmenting the state, so it remains compatible with associative parallel scan.","experiments":"The paper reports experiments across language, vision, and time-series settings, and evaluates MuonSSM-style modifications on several SSM backbones rather than presenting only a single architecture. reads the scratchpad states it writes. More precisely, after the model emits an intermediate state in a reasoning trace, do later tokens compute from that state, or is the state merely plausible text correlated with the final answer? The authors make this question testable with controlled finite state-tracking tasks and causal interventions on the internal representation of a written state.","importance":"The work is directly relevant to process supervision, chain-of-thought training, and mechanistic evaluation. It separates three notions that are often conflated: writing an intermediate state, representing that state internally, and using that state in later computation. The main result is careful: running-state supervision can make a scratchpad state causally usable, while pretrained and final-answer-only controls show little of this behavior. For pretraining research, the implication is that reasoning traces are not just extra tokens; their value depends on whether they train variables that later tokens can read and update. At evaluation time, the visible scratchpad text is held fixed, while the internal representation associated with one written state token is edited, especially the phase bit. Because the transition rule is known, the correct downstream consequence is unique: the next state should be computed from the edited state and the current move. 等生产级任务中验证，对预训练优化器栈的下一代演进（从逐元素到矩阵感知）有直接的工程落地价值，也为 FSDP/ZeRO 与非逐元素优化器的兼容设计提供了明确方向。","technical_approach":"DMuon 是一个可即插即用的分布式 Muon 模块，与宿主训练框架、并行策略解耦，核心设计分四层：1) owner-centric 通信优化：为每个完整矩阵选定一个 owner rank，非 owner 把各自 shard 通过一次 all-gather 聚合到 owner，在 owner 上执行完整 Newton-Schulz 迭代后再把更新后的 shard 分发回去，通信量最小且保留精确优化器语义；避免了逐 shard 计算无法正交化的根本问题。2) 形状自适应执行栈：采用批量 Gram Newton-Schulz 执行（先算 M M^T / M^T M 再迭代，减少运算量）、对称感知专用 kernel（利用 Gram 矩阵对称减半计算）、DSL 驱动的自动调优，在异构形状的大量矩阵上都能达到高算力利用率。3) 计算感知负载均衡：将 owner 分配建模为基于实测耗时的优化问题，结合 batching、kernel 选择、自动调优带来的非线性开销，在运行时 profile 后做全局分配，避免 owner 之间负载不均。4) 里反复出现、但常被粗略归因为“深层梯度变小”的现象：越靠后的层，功能贡献往往越弱，表示也更冗余。作者给出的更精确问题定义是，问题不只是梯度幅值衰减，而是残差结构导致的梯度组合来源不对称。浅层能汇聚更多下游路径传回来的梯度信号，深层只能接收更少、更简单的组合信号。作者把这种结构性差异称为 Gradient Fan-in Asymmetry，简称 GFA。论文的核心任务有两部分：一是证明这种“梯度扇入不对称”比单纯的梯度大小更能解释深层层冗余；二是把这个解释落到两个可操作方向上，一个是训练时就内生化这种不对称的深度渐缩架构 CascadeFormer，另一个是仅依赖训练过程中累计梯度来做层裁剪的 CascadeFlow scaling/架构设计直接相关的思路：如果不同深度天然接收到的信息密度不同，那么统一宽度堆叠未必是最合适的参数分配方式，深度越深越窄反而可能更贴近训练信号分布。第三，它提出的 pruning 信号来自训练期累计梯度，而不是训练后再做昂贵分析，这对大模型训练中的在线结构决策、mid-train 裁剪、甚至动态深度设计都有启发。贡献量级上，这不是改写主流 recipe proxy：某层能聚合多少个不同下游信号通道，也就是 fan-in。这个 fan-in 随深度线性下降；如果再加中间层辅助监督，浅层会收到更多层级的反传信号，差异会进一步放大到近似二次级别。第二步是做相关性和干预验证。作者先测每层平均梯度范数与最终功能重要性 ΔMi 的正相关，再做两个更关键的 intervention。一个是“幅值补偿”实验：人为放大后层梯度，使其梯度大小更接近前层，但并不能恢复这些层的功能重要性。另一个是“结构补偿”实验：通过 layer repetition 增加后层可接收的路径数，结果能明显恢复其重要性。这个对照是全文最关键的论据，因为它把“梯度大小只是症状”这个说法变成了可检验命题。第三步是方法落地。CascadeFormer 不是简单减层，而是在固定训练 FLOPs 约束下做 depth-tapered width schedule：前层更宽，后层逐步变窄，让容量分配与梯度组合多样性更匹配。它保留标准 Transformer block 形式，只改每层宽度配置，因此兼容现有训练流程。CascadeFlow Pruning 则在训练过程中累计每层梯度统计，把它作为结构重要性的 proxy，直接决定裁掉哪些层。它强调不需要训练后再跑额外敏感性分析，也不依赖激活重放或复杂搜索。和常见按层位置、按权重范数、按单次梯度或按表示相似度裁剪相比，它利用的是训练全过程积累下来的“被多少有用信号持续驱动过”的信息。","experiments":"实验覆盖从头训练、最大到 1.2B 参数规模的模型。论文先给出现象层证据：在预训练后的 LLaMA 上，后层表示相似度更高；在 iterate, as averaging improves optimization stability and final performance. The key observation is that gradient update operators are generally non-commutative, so training on A then B and B then A can lead to different parameter states and different target losses.","importance":"The main contribution is a computable primitive for data-order planning. PTQ，位宽为INT4、INT3。核心结果：1）INT4/INT3量化在多数推理benchmark上最终答案准确率损失<2%（几乎无损），但CTIR可达1.15~1.4（推理token数增加15%~40%）；例如MoE模型的INT3量化在AIME25上准确率仅降0.3%，但CTIR达1.32。2）膨胀程度与任务推理强度正相关：轻推理的通用语言benchmark（HellaSwag、MMLU-Pro）的CTIR仅1.02~1.07，几乎无膨胀。3）行为层面：量化模型的推理轨迹中，语义重复片段占比提升8%~15%，中间验证步骤数量增加20%以上，这些额外步骤未带来正确率提升。4）缓解策略效果：prompt要求简洁仅在部分benchmark上降低CTIR，同时导致准确率下降3%~5%；解码硬截断推理长度会大幅降低正确率；QAT可将准确率损失控制在1%以内，同时将CTIR降到1.05以内，是当前最优的缓解方向。","reading_guide":"精读优先级：1）第4章的核心实验结果表格，重点对比不同模型、不同量化位宽、不同任务下的CTIR与准确率变化，这是全文的核心实证依据；2）第6章的行为分析部分，明确膨胀的具体表现是重复推理而非冗余措辞，理解其对计算成本的实际影响；3）第5章CTIR的定义与计算细节，注意推理token与答案token的拆分逻辑，避免后续复现或使用时出现指标偏差；4）第7章的缓解策略对比，重点分析QAT能同时控制精度损失和token膨胀的内在原因。可跳过附录中具体量化算法的参数配置细节（除非从事量化工程落地）。值得深挖的方向：推理模型的数值精度如何影响其“终止推理、输出答案”的决策阈值，是否可以在预训练、RL训练阶段引入推理长度正则化，来提升模型的量化鲁棒性，从训练源头降低部署时的隐藏成本。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"Existing Kaplan 体系：分别考察 test loss 对参数量 N、数据量 D、计算量 C 的幂律关系，并强调联合形式里过拟合程度主要由 N^(alpha/beta)/D 这样的比例控制。这一步的关键是，Kaplan 的结论建立在当时的实验覆盖范围和拟合方式上，因此会把 compute-optimal 点推向“更大的模型、相对更少的 token”。\n\n接着文章详细拆解 Chinchilla 的三种方法。Method 1 是固定模型大小、扫描 token budget，看每个模型在不同训练 token 下的最优点；Method 2 是 IsoFLOP profiles，在固定总计算预算下比较不同 N–D 组合；Method 3 是直接对联合损失函数做参数化拟合。作者强调，三种方法并不是简单替代关系，而是各自对不同误差源敏感：固定模型扫 token 更容易看清 undertraining；IsoFLOP 更贴近真实 compute allocation；参数化拟合最省实验，但对函数形式和采样区域很敏感。\n\n文章一个很有用的部分是“现实中的拟合陷阱”。它指出，如果实验点主要落在 data-infinite 或 model-limited 的局部区域，拟合出来的指数会带明显偏差；如果把尚未充分训练的点混入拟合，或者用过窄的模型/数据范围外推，最后得到的 As the number of gradient steps per rollout increases, the current policy drifts away from the behavior policy, the ratio distribution changes across token groups, and this changes both which tokens dominate the effective gradient and how far the update direction rotates away from the on-policy target.","importance":"This matters beyond a narrow RLVR recipe discussion. First, it reframes reasoning RL analysis around expected effective gradient under clipping, rather than local intuitions about “important tokens.” That is a cleaner object for understanding training dynamics. Second, it shows that update-to-rollout ratio is not a mere systems knob; it changes the optimization regime itself. That is relevant for large-scale RL where rollout generation and parameter updates have very different costs. Third, the paper makes a strong case that a single global clipping window is structurally mismatched to heterogeneous ratio dispersion across token groups and training regimes. The theoretical contribution is mainly explanatory, but it is useful explanatory work. Bias）：E2M1这类非均匀浮点格式的可表示值按几何间距排列，相邻值的舍入区间天然不对称——区间中点更靠近小值一端，在业界默认的就近偶舍入（RTNE，确定性舍入）规则下，落入每个区间的数的量化期望会系统性偏小，形成稳定的负舍入误差。理论分析表明，这种偏差是跨层乘性累积的，不会像零均值加性噪声那样在训练中相互抵消。此前业界选择E2M1的直觉是其非均匀结构更适配张量的重尾分布、动态范围更优，但配套使用的RHT（原本用来打散离群值、提升码本利用率）会将张量能量均匀分散，形成近似高斯的近零分布，恰好落在E2M1区间不对称性最严重的数值范围，反而放大了收缩偏差。而E1M2/INT4这类均匀格式的可表示值等间距分布，从根本上不存在几何不对称带来的偏差，且和RHT之后的近高斯分布匹配度更高，能把RHT带来的码本利用率提升转化为更稳定的量化精度。基于这一发现设计的UFP4训练recipe做了两个关键选择：一是在前向、数据梯度、权重梯度三个线性层GEMM路径上全部应用RHT，解决了此前E2M1方案中全路径RHT易引发训练崩溃的问题；二是仅在量化上游梯度dY时使用随机舍入，权重和激活量化均使用确定性RTNE，减少随机舍入带来的更新方差。和现有E2M1方案的核心区别是：现有方案始终保留E2M1格式，通过调整缩放规则、增加离群值裁剪、扩大随机舍入范围等外围策略稳训练；UFP4直接修正了格式与RHT后张量分布的错配，无需复杂的稳定化策略即可实现稳定的端到端FP4训练。","experiments":"验证覆盖三个规模的完整长程预训练：1.5B A shared residual block is applied N times, but the usual deep-residual rule ε=1/√N does not keep the residual stream stable and does not make the learning rate transferable across loop counts. The failure comes from weight sharing: residual updates across loop steps are correlated, so they add constructively rather than as an independent-layer random walk.","importance":"The result is relevant to pretraining recipes for recurrent-depth Transformers, Universal Transformer variants, ALBERT-style tying, and latent-computation models. These models try to buy more effective depth without adding parameters, but increasing the loop count often causes activation growth and learning-rate fragility. The paper gives a practical rule: use ε=1/N for a single shared block, and ε=λ/(N√L) when L unique layers are each looped N times. It also clarifies a broader point: depth-scaling laws derived under independent weights cannot be directly reused for parameter-shared networks.","technical_approach":"$a83","experiments":"The experiments train decoder-only Transformers on FineWeb-Edu. They test three main predictions. First, activation-norm measurements show that ε=1/√L controls norms in non-shared deep networks, but ε=1/√N fails in looped networks as N increases; ε=1/N keeps the residual stream bounded. Second, pairwise cosine similarities between loop-step updates are densely positive, and this correlation persists through training rather than appearing only at initialization. Third, learning-rate sweeps over N∈{1,2,4,8} show that linear residual scaling keeps the near-optimal learning rate almost invariant, while square-root scaling shifts the optimum and makes training more sensitive. 的熵变化可以分解为 trajectory-level advantage 与一个由 next-token distribution 决定的局部 entropy sensitivity function 的乘积。这个分解导出 advantage-surprisal 四象限结构：正 advantage/低 surprisal token 倾向于降低熵，正 advantage/高 surprisal token 倾向于提高熵；负 advantage 下方向相反。由于低 surprisal token 出现频率高，它们在实际梯度中占主导，造成熵下降偏置。论文进一步提出 near-criticality：只要对特定 token 的权重做温和扰动，就能翻转 batch-level entropy evolution 的方向；超过临界点后，权重主要影响熵变化幅度，而不是方向。STARE 据此做三件事。第一，用 batch 内 surprisal 分位数识别 entropy-critical token，而不是依赖绝对阈值，这使方法对模型尺度和任务分布更稳。第二，对正 advantage 的高 surprisal token 放大 effective advantage，对负 advantage 的高 surprisal token 降低 effective advantage，从而补偿稀有探索 token 在梯度中的弱势。第三，引入 target-entropy closed-loop gate：当 batch 平均熵低于目标熵时启用重加权，熵恢复后退回普通 GRPO。与 DAPO 的 clip-higher 相比，STARE 不依赖 importance ratio 明显偏离 1；在近 on-policy 训练中也能直接作用于 token credit。与 entropy bonus 相比，它不统一推高所有高熵位置，而是只干预由 surprisal 和 advantage 共同定义的关键 token。","experiments":"论文覆盖 1.5B 到 32B 模型，以及 Short CoT、Long CoT、多轮 tool-use agent 三类任务。报告中最重要的训练稳定性结果是：7B 模型上 STARE 可以稳定训练超过 5k RL steps；14B 和 32B 模型上可以稳定超过 1.5k steps；训练期间 policy entropy 被维持在目标区间内。效果上，STARE 在 AIME24 和 AIME25 上相对 DAPO 有稳定提升，平均准确率提升约 4% 到 8%。论文还报告了 reflection-related tokens 和 response length 随训练增长，说明方法没有单纯压制生成长度或把策略固定到短答案，而是在保持探索的同时继续强化长推理行为。消融层面，最值得关注的是 surprisal token 子集选择、不同重加权强度、目标熵门控、以及与 DAPO clip-higher/entropy-aware advantage reshaping 的对比。near-criticality 的实验如果成立，说明权重超参不需要精细调到某个窄区间，这对大规模 RL 工程很重要。","reading_guide":"建议精读 Section 3 的 entropy dynamics 推导，这是论文的核心。重点看 per-token entropy variation 如何写成 advantage 与 sensitivity function 的乘积，以及四象限图如何解释正负样本中的熵变化方向。随后看 STARE 算法部分，尤其是 batch-internal surprisal quantile 的定义、positive/negative advantage 下的重加权规则、target entropy gate 的触发条件。实验部分优先看训练曲线，而不是只看最终准确率：policy entropy、reward、response length、reflection token 频率、组内 rollout 多样性这些曲线能判断方法是否真的延长了可训练区间。附录中的消融和超参敏感性也值得看，尤其是 near-criticality 的证据、不同模型尺度下目标熵设定是否需要重调、以及对 tool-use 场景的失败样例分析。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper addresses policy entropy collapse in GRPO-style RLVR training. The central issue is not merely the lack of an entropy bonus. It is a token-level credit assignment mismatch: a single trajectory-level advantage is applied to every token in a rollout, while each token has a different local effect on entropy. In positive-advantage rollouts, frequent low-surprisal tokens dominate the gradient and tend to sharpen the policy. Rare high-surprisal tokens, which could preserve exploration, are underrepresented. A mirrored imbalance appears in negative-advantage rollouts. This homogenizes rollouts, weakens group-relative advantage estimation, and limits long-horizon RL training.","importance":"The paper is useful because it turns entropy stability in RLVR from a trajectory-level heuristic problem into a token-level training-dynamics problem. This matters for foundation-model training because RLVR is now part of the feedback loop between pretraining, reasoning data generation, and continued training. If the RL stage collapses exploration too early, it also biases the distribution of long-CoT traces and synthetic reasoning data. STARE is not a large new RL framework. Its contribution is a low-intrusion reweighting mechanism inside the GRPO clipped surrogate, governed by a target-entropy feedback gate. The practical message is that entropy collapse can be controlled by rebalancing the advantage of a small set of entropy-critical tokens, rather than by globally changing clipping, KL penalties, or entropy regularization.","technical_approach":"$a87","experiments":"The experiments cover model scales from 1.5B to 32B and three regimes: Short CoT, Long CoT, and multi-turn tool-use agents. On AIME24 and AIME25, it improves average accuracy over DAPO by about 4% to 8%. The paper also reports that reflection-related tokens and response length grow during training, suggesting that the method does not simply suppress generation length or force early convergence to short answers. The most informative ablations are the surprisal-based token subset, the reweighting strength, the target-entropy gate, and comparisons against clip-higher and entropy-aware advantage reshaping. The near-criticality experiments are especially important because they indicate whether the method avoids narrow hyperparameter tuning.","reading_guide":"Read Section 3 carefully. 更稳健。\n（注：你提供的全文片段只到方法与分析开头，未包含具体任务列表、指标与数值表；精确提升幅度需要对照实验章节的表格与消融。）","reading_guide":"精读建议：\n- 先看“[EOS] overflow 机制分析”那一节：它解释了为什么 AR 里安全、MDLM 里不安全，决定你是否也需要在自家 MDLM/any-order 模型里引入类似的 token 语义分离。\n- selection。前两类是已有文献常见设定：replace 只用新一轮合成数据，已知会快速坍塌；accumulate 把历史真实数据持续保留，能避免方差发散，但在很多低资源场景里真实数据规模太小，后续仍会被大量合成数据主导。论文关心的是更常见也更被寄予希望的 selection：每一轮先生成候选合成样本，再用 verifier 选出“高质量”子集用于下一轮训练。\n\n核心创新在于把 interpolation，即在两个或多个局部分布之间沿最优传输路径做插值；另一种是 Wasserstein barycenter，即求多个局部分布的几何中心。然后用这些代理分布替代单一 silo 的本地参考，对合成样本进行联合打分或筛选。这样做的理由很明确：如果单个 verifier 只能看到局部切片，那么就需要一个不暴露原始样本、但能在分布层面整合多方信息的参考对象。与直接平均特征、参数平均或简单投票不同，Wasserstein 代理保留了分布几何结构，尤其适合分析尾部覆盖和模式迁移。论文还讨论了理论上若 verifier 能访问全局 ground truth，selection more specific failure mode than the usual “synthetic data causes model collapse” story. Its target is recursive training with sample selection, under the realistic condition that the verifier only has access to a small, biased, local slice of the target distribution. This happens naturally in data silos such as hospitals, banks, or privacy-constrained consortia, where raw data cannot be pooled. In that setting, selection is no longer an unbiased quality filter. It becomes a local-prior amplifier: synthetic samples that align with the silo’s own manifold are retained, while globally valid but locally rare modes are discarded. That matters for synthetic pretraining, continual pretraining, domain adaptation, and federated or siloed training pipelines. size、序列长度、激活重计算策略和并行切分空间。已有路线主要有两类：一类是像 Adam-mini 那样按人工规则共享二阶矩，另一类是对优化器状态做量化。但前者依赖架构先验和张量命名，泛化性差；后者通常用手工 codebook 或 block-wise 量化，存在额外超参和失真控制问题。Gefen 要解决的是：在不依赖人工分组规则的前提下，自动找到适合共享二阶矩的参数块，并进一步压缩一阶矩状态，把 GiB。这种量级的节省，在大模型预训练里通常可以换成更大的全局 batch、更长上下文、更少的并行碎片，或者在同样硬件上训练更大的模型。更重要的是，它给“为什么可以共享二阶矩”补上了比经验规则更扎实的解释：高 Hessian 耦合的参数，其平方梯度比值会被约束到更接近 1，因此共享 v 不是纯经验近似，而是有局部曲率上的依据。对做训练 recipe、优化器状态压缩、甚至 ZeRO/分布式内存预算的人，这篇都值得认真看。","technical_approach":"方法分两部分。第一部分是二阶矩共享。作者先从一个两层 MLP 的理论分析出发，研究混合 Hessian 项较大时，不同参数的平方梯度何时会接近。结论是：在可行的 Hessian 范围内，混合 Hessian 的绝对值越大，两个参数平方梯度之比允许的区间越收缩到 1 附近。这给出了一个很清楚的设计信号：如果一组参数在 Hessian 上强耦合，那么它们共享 Adam 的二阶矩估计，失真会比较小。问题在于大模型里不能显式算 Hessian，所以 Gefen 不直接估 Hessian，而是用首步梯度 g0 的平方结构做代理。具体做法是：对每个参数张量先展平，对长度 n 的张量枚举其所有 proper divisors p，把 g0^2 reshape 成若干个连续 block，每个 block 大小为 p，然后计算块内异质性指标 E(p)。E(p) 小，说明这个分块下块内平方梯度更相似，适合共享一个二阶矩标量；p 大则共享更激进、更省内存。算法在“更大块、更低异质性”之间做权衡，自动选出分块周期。这里一个有意思的点是，E(p) 不一定随 p 单调变差；某些更大的 divisor 反而更贴合真实结构，比如 attention head 或卷积通道带来的块结构，所以自动搜索比手工按名字切块更稳。\n\n第二部分是一阶矩压缩。Gefen 不是简单做低比特均匀量化，而是复用前面得到的 block partition，对一阶矩 m 做基于可学习 codebook 的量化，并且量化分配通过动态规划精确求解。作者强调两点：一是 codebook 是学习得到的，不是手工固定；二是复用同一套 block 划分，因此不会再引入一个独立的 block-size 超参。整体上，Gefen 可以理解为：v 用共享标量做结构化压缩，m 用 codebook 做离散压缩，两者都围绕同一个自动发现的参数块结构展开。这样设计比单独压 v 或单独量化 m 更完整，也比 Adam-mini 这类依赖架构规则的方法更通用。","experiments":"从文中给出的主结果看，Gefen 的核心结论有三层。第一层是内存：相对 AdamW，优化器状态内存约缩小 8×，作者给出的换算是每 1B 参数节省约 6.5 GiB。这是最硬的结果。第二层是性能保持：在 LLM 和非 LLM 网络上，Gefen 都能维持与 AdamW 可比的训练质量，部分设置下还有小幅收益。引言里明确说它在多种模型和数据集上取得了最低的内存占用，同时质量和吞吐与对比方法相当或更好。第三层是自动分组的有效性：论文不仅给了两层 MLP 的理论，还在附录展示了真实网络张量——包括 attention tensor 和卷积层——中，按自动发现的块结构切分后，平方梯度在块内更一致，这支持了“用首步梯度结构近似 Hessian 耦合”的经验合理性。\n\n和基线的比较重点应当包括 AdamW、Adam-mini，以及量化优化器一类方法。Adam-mini 的问题是需要用户提供架构信息，例如 attention heads 数量，还依赖 tensor name；Gefen 则完全自动。量化优化器的常见问题是手工 codebook 和额外 block-size 超参；Gefen 用 learned codebook 和动态规划避免了这点。文中还强调吞吐没有因为自动分组而明显受损，因为分组只在第一步基于 g0 推断一次，而不是训练中持续重估。精读时建议重点核对实验表里不同模型规模、不同任务上的最终 loss / accuracy / perplexity 差异，以及消融里“只共享 v”“只量化 m”“自动分组 vs 手工分组”的对比，这些最能看出方法是否只是内存换质量，还是确实找到了较优折中。","reading_guide":"建议按“理论—算法—实验”三段读。\n\n先看理论分析部分，重点抓住那个核心命题：混合 Hessian 大，平方梯度比值会被压向 1。这里不用过度纠缠证明细节，但要看清假设条件、适用对象，以及作者为什么说这个现象不仅出现在两层 MLP，也能在真实网络张量里观察到。这个部分决定了方法不是拍脑袋做 block sharing。\n\n再看算法部分。需要重点理解三个点：第一，为什么只用第一步梯度 g0 就足够推断共享结构；第二，E(p) 这个异质性指标如何定义、如何在内存和失真之间选 p；第三，一阶矩量化为什么要和同一套 training: AdamW’s optimizer states are expensive. Standard AdamW stores both first and second moments, so optimizer memory is roughly 2× parameter memory on top of the weights themselves. At LLM scale, this directly constrains batch size, context length, activation checkpointing choices, and parallelization strategy. Existing memory-saving alternatives are unsatisfactory in different ways. Manual sharing schemes such as Adam-mini rely on architecture-specific heuristics and tensor-name conventions. Quantized optimizers reduce memory, but often depend on hand-crafted codebooks and introduce extra tuning knobs such as quantization block size. Gefen aims to remove these weaknesses at once: automatically discover which parameters can share second-moment statistics, compress first moments as well, and preserve AdamW-like optimization behavior without requiring model-specific rules.","importance":"This matters for pretraining in a very practical sense. The contribution is not just a lighter optimizer implementation; it connects theory, algorithm design, and systems impact. The reported reduction is about 8× in optimizer-state memory, or roughly 6.5 GiB saved per 1B parameters. At current model scales, that is large enough to change feasible training regimes: larger global batch, longer sequences, fewer memory-driven compromises, or simply larger models on the same hardware budget. The more interesting part is conceptual. The paper gives a principled reason for sharing second moments: if two parameters have strong mixed-Hessian coupling, their squared gradients are constrained to be similar, so sharing v is not merely a heuristic. For researchers working on optimizer design, memory-efficient pretraining, or distributed training budgets, this is a useful piece of work because it turns an empirical trick into a more grounded confidence 的 remasking 到底什么时候真的有用。已有工作把 remasking 作为对 masked dLLM 早期决策错误的自然补救，因为一旦 token 被 unmask，标准 masked diffusion 解码就不能再改它。问题在于，早期结果往往把 remasking 的收益和更强的 confidence-based unmasking 混在一起，没有把额外延迟成本、解码策略、采样温度、block size 等因素拆开。作者重新评估代表性方法 WINO，结论很明确：在标准设置下，post-hoc confidence remasking 的增益远小于先前印象，很多时候几乎没有净收益；只有在特定解码条件下，它才会表现出可见帮助。","importance":"这篇工作对新型语言建模范式很重要，尤其是 masked diffusion / any-order LM 方向。它的价值不在提出新算法，而在于把一个正在快速扩散的经验判断纠正过来：masked dLLM 的“可自我修正”并不是只要加一个训练后 remasking 模块就自然成立。作者指出，remasking 是否有效，取决于底层模型在被重新 mask 后，是否真的有能力提出更好的替代 token；如果模型本身没有这种条件分布修正能力，remasking 模块分布失配。作者在理论与实验分解后给出结论：熵是主因，policy 更新带来的 mismatch 很小（文中 Fig.3）。\n2) 关键理论点：\n- 常见的“target-only”验证/接受策略（用 draft 的 argmax 生成候选、验证时只看 target 概率且不缓存 draft 概率）下，acceptance 受到 max_y p(y) 的硬上界约束；当熵上升时，max The paper reports that high-temperature synthetic canaries produce stronger attack signals than literature baselines in the LoRA setting. The proxy audit based on an auxiliary attack model is more sensitive than audits based on verbatim regurgitation or direct semantic similarity. A key ablation varies LoRA rank and canary entropy: the entropy level that maximizes memorization increases with LoRA rank, while reconstruction attacks peak at lower entropy than membership inference attacks. Standard log-likelihood scoring does not only measure whether a model knows the answer; it also measures how familiar the model is with the exact answer string. Since MCQA compares probabilities over concrete option tokens, paraphrases, lexical variants, language-specific phrasing, frequency effects, and tokenization can all change the score. The authors isolate this issue with controlled models that share the same underlying knowledge but differ in surface form.","importance":"The main contribution is an evaluation diagnosis with direct implications for pretraining research. Base-model comparisons, data-mixture decisions, scaling analyses, and checkpoint selection often rely on MCQA scores. If those scores are sensitive to answer phrasing, differences in pretraining distribution, language mix, lexical frequency, and tokenizer behavior can be mistaken for differences in knowledge. The reported effect size is large enough to matter for model development: matched models trained on the same underlying knowledge can show artificial gaps above 2 points and up to about 4 points under standard scoring; paraphrasing only the correct answer can move accuracy by 5 to 8 points. ParaEval reduces gaps between matched-knowledge models to below 1 percentage point and cuts benchmark gaps by 14% to 96%.","technical_approach":"$ac2","experiments":"The experiments center on three findings. First, in the controlled 1B, 3B, and 8B matched-model setting, standard MCQA reports non-trivial performance gaps despite the models having the same underlying knowledge; the paper reports artificial gaps above 2 points and up to about 4 points. Second, answer phrasing alone has a strong effect: paraphrasing only the correct option increases accuracy by 5 to 8 points, and common length normalizations do not remove the artifact. The authors also report gaps above 6 points from rephrasing correct answers. Third, ParaEval substantially reduces the mismatch. With paraphrase-augmented scoring over all options, gaps between matched-knowledge models fall below 1 absolute point across benchmarks, with 14% to 96% reductions. Similar phrasing sensitivity is observed in 70B and 120B open-source models, suggesting that the issue is not limited to small models. In the experiments, prioritize the figures and tables showing standard MCQA gaps on matched models, the effect of paraphrasing only correct answers, and the reduction after ParaEval. In this setup, the same model is used twice: a student conditioned only on the question, and a self-teacher conditioned on the question plus extra context. The training objective matches the student distribution to the contextualized self-teacher distribution. The central question is whether the context should be a scalar reward, a reference solution, or feedback aligned to the model’s own reasoning trace.","importance":"The main contribution is the separation between feedback quality and feedback alignment. A reference solution can be correct and complete, but it may follow a different trajectory from the model’s own rollout, which makes the induced token-level signal diffuse. Step-aligned critique produces a more localized update around the parts of the trace where the reasoning goes wrong. GPT-2 large），计算其每 token 负对数似然。这个量只反映“样本对该 scorer 来说有多可预测”，并不直接反映语法完整性、语义连贯性、篇章一致性，更不反映样本分布是否接近人类文本。论文要解决的核心问题，就是证明这种错位不是边角问题，而是结构性缺陷：存在大量低质量、甚至明显胡乱的文本，在冻结 AR scorer 下依然能拿到很低的 gen-PPL；因此用它来追踪非 AR LM 偏好的可预测串”，不能说明“更接近真实文本分布”。第二层是研究方向层面。非 AR 语言建模一直面临 exact likelihood 难算、采样策略多样、推断步数影响结果等问题，社区因此依赖代理指标。本文的贡献在于把这个代理指标的失效机制讲清楚，并给出替代思路：不要再问样本在某个 AR 模型下是否容易预测，而要问生成分布与人类文本分布之间的统计距离。对做新型语言建模范式的人，这篇文章的价值不在于提出一个新模型，而在于纠正“优化错目标”的风险，量级上属于会影响后续实验 protocol 的工作。","technical_approach":"技术路线分三步。第一步是理论和概念拆解。作者把 gen-PPL 重新解释为“冻结 AR scorer 对样本序列的条件可预测性”，并指出这与生成质量不是同一个对象。一个强 AR scorer 会偏好高频局部模式、常见搭配、短程可预测结构；但文本质量还包含长程语义、全局一致性、信息密度、 discourse 合理性。只要能构造出在局部上高度可预测、在全局上却很差的序列，gen-PPL 就会失真。经验熵 guardrail 也不够，因为 unigram entropy (gen-PPL) is a valid proxy for unconditional generation quality. The answer developed through the full paper is no. Gen-PPL evaluates generated samples under a frozen autoregressive scorer, usually GPT-2 large, and reports token-level negative log-likelihood. That quantity measures how predictable a sample is to the scorer, not whether the sample is grammatical, coherent, semantically meaningful, or distributionally close to human text. The central problem is therefore not a small mismatch but a structural one: there exists a large combinatorial set of low-quality sequences that are still highly predictable under the scorer, so progress measured by gen-PPL can be badly misranked.","importance":"Its importance is mainly methodological. First, Orthogonalize Later: Understanding Momentum in Muon via Spectral Filtering","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"must_read","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"hf_upvotes":0,"cover_url":"/covers/2606_03899.png","published_at":"2026-06-02T16:54:38+00:00","arxiv_categories":["cs.LG"],"recommendation":{"zh":"清晰解释了Muon动量的作用机制，先动量后正交的顺序结论可直接用于内部优化器消融实验验证","en":"Clearly explains the mechanism of momentum in Muon, the momentum-before-orthogonalization conclusion can be directly used for internal optimizer ablation verification"},"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作要解释的是：Muon 里为什么 momentum 这么重要，以及为什么必须先做 momentum 再做 orthogonalization。已有理论大多把 Muon 的极分解/极化更新单独拿出来分析，或者保留 momentum 但只能给出收敛上界，结论往往还是“重 momentum 不一定有益”。这和预训练里的经验现象不一致：标准 Muon 明显依赖 momentum，而且把正交化放在 momentum 前面会变差。论文抓住的核心不是一般意义上的“加速”，而是矩阵梯度流里的谱结构稳定性。作者要说明，momentum 在 Muon 中首先扮演的是谱滤波器：它先压低扰动方向、保留持续存在的主信号方向，拉开 signal/noise 的奇异值间隔；随后正交化才有可靠对象可作用。如果先正交化，奇异值幅度信息被抹平，后续再做 momentum 已经无法恢复信号与噪声的可分性。","importance":"对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 Muon 这类矩阵优化器里一个长期悬而未决的问题讲清楚了：性能提升不只是“正交化更新”本身，而是“先滤波、后极化”这个顺序。第二，这个解释直接关系到大模型训练 recipe。很多优化器设计会把归一化、投影、正交化、动量、预条件等操作视作可交换模块，这篇工作说明在矩阵更新里顺序本身就是机制的一部分。第三，它给了一个比收敛率更贴近预训练实践的分析视角：不是只看目标函数下降，而是看梯度矩阵的谱间隔、主奇异子空间稳定性、以及这些量如何影响后续更新可靠性。对做 optimizer ablation、训练稳定性诊断、以及理解 matrix-valued update 为什么在 LLM pretrain 中有效，都有直接启发。贡献量级上，它更像是对 Muon 机制的关键补全，而不是提出全新优化器。","technical_approach":"技术路线分成理论建模、顺序比较、以及与预训练现象对齐三部分。理论上，作者采用 structured signal-plus-perturbation 的梯度模型，把每步梯度写成持续存在的低秩 coherent signal 加上均值为零、方差有界、并与信号正交的扰动项。这个设定的关键不是追求最一般，而是刻画预训练中常见的情形：有一部分跨 step 稳定存在的方向，对应可积累的学习信号；同时有高频、各向分散的噪声。\n\n在这个模型下，作者分析三条 pipeline：标准 Muon 的 pre-polar，即先形成 momentum buffer M_t=βM_{t-1}+(1-β)G_t，再取 polar factor O(M_t)；Orthogonal-SGDM 风格的 post-polar，即先对每步梯度做 O(G_t) 再做 momentum；以及不带 momentum 的 polar-only。核心结论有两步。第一步，momentum 对原始梯度流起到谱低通滤波作用。由于 coherent signal 在时间上持续，动量累积会保留并放大这部分结构；而均值为零的扰动会在时间平均中被压制。结果是第 r 和 r+1 个奇异值之间的 gap 随有效窗口增大而拉开，top-r 奇异子空间更稳定。作者用定理和推论把这种“谱间隔扩大—子空间更可靠”的链条形式化。第二步，polar update 的性质决定了它只能保留奇异向量方向，不能保留奇异值大小。一旦对 noisy gradient 直接做 polar，信号与噪声在幅度上的差异被抹掉，后面再做 momentum 只能在已经失真的方向上平滑，无法重新建立谱分离。因此 pre-polar 优于 post-polar 不是经验巧合，而是由非交换性和信息保真顺序决定的。\n\n论文还给出定量分离结果：在固定信号矩阵下，pre-polar 的更新方向与真实信号子空间更接近，post-polar 和 polar-only 会受到更大的扰动偏移。这里值得注意的一点是，作者不是简单说“momentum 降噪”，而是把降噪具体化为“为后续极化创造可辨识的谱结构”。这比传统 SGDM 分析更贴近 Muon 的特殊性。","experiments":"实验部分的重点不是刷任务，而是验证理论预测和顺序效应。文中首先在预训练曲线上比较 pre-polar、post-polar、polar-only，结论很稳定：标准 Muon 的 pre-polar 全程优于另外两种变体，说明 momentum 既不能删，也不能随意换顺序。摘要截断前已经明确指出 Figure 1 展示了这一趋势；从引言叙述看，这个差距贯穿训练过程，而不是只在早期出现。\n\n更关键的实验应当是围绕谱量展开：作者检查 momentum buffer 与原始梯度在奇异值分布、谱间隔、以及主奇异子空间对齐上的差异，验证“momentum 先扩大 gap，再让 polar 更可靠”这一机制。按全文结构，理论部分给出 Theorem 1、Corollary 1、Theorem 2、3，对应实验通常会展示：随着 momentum window 或 β 增大，M_t 的 top-r / tail singular separation 更明显；pre-polar 的更新与信号矩阵的夹角更小；post-polar 因为先把 singular values 全部压成 1，后续无法恢复这种 separation。引言还提到 heavier momentum 在旧理论里会恶化收敛上界，但实践中 Muon 受益于 momentum，这篇工作用谱分析解释了这个表面矛盾。\n\n从你给出的全文片段里，没有完整保留具体参数量、token 数、或精确提升数字，因此不能编造数值。阅读时应重点去正文实验节和附录表格核对三类信息：一是预训练设置规模，二是不同 β 并不是在逼近人类评价函数，而是在一个低秩、冗余、偏向模型可读特征的子空间里彼此对齐。于是 inter-LLM consensus 不能当作 human alignment 的替代证据。","importance":"对基座研究的影响比题目看上去更大。第一，它直接触及 post-train 与 eval 的接口：现在大量偏好数据构造、reward model 校验、自动评测、self-improvement pipeline 都默认 LLM judge 可作为廉价代理。如果 judge 之间的一致性主要来自共享投影偏差，那么很多训练信号会系统性偏离人类目标，尤其在主观、跨文化、多语言任务上。第二，这篇工作把“judge failure”从零散现象上升为几何结构问题，给出可操作的诊断量，而不是只报几个相关系数。第三，它对预训练研究也有反向启发：如果 judge 子空间更贴近语料频繁、流畅性主导、模型熟悉的方向，那么 pretrain 数据分布、post-train 偏好目标和评测协议之间可能在共同塑造一种低维偏差。这个结论对做 reward 建模、合成偏好数据、自动化 eval 的人都很重要。","technical_approach":"技术上最有价值的是它把 LLM-as-judge 形式化成“潜在质量流形上的低秩投影器”。作者先假设一个回答表示 h 可以分解为 style、fact、culture 等近似正交的子空间；人类评分函数会按 rubric 在这些子空间上加权，客观 rubric 更偏 fact，主观 rubric 则会把 cultural/contextual 维度也纳入。LLM judge 则被建模为一个秩较低的正交投影 PJ，分数由投影后能量决定。若 judge 的表征基础主要来自 next-token 预训练和常见 post-train 目标，它更容易对 fluency、常见事实、模型熟悉的表达方向敏感，而对文化语境、社区规范、细微价值判断这些低频但人类在意的维度投影不足。这样就会出现：不同 LLM judge 因共享训练分布和对齐目标而投向相似低维子空间，所以彼此相关；但这个子空间和人类评分子空间夹角很大，所以和人类不对齐。\n\n围绕这个几何假设，论文提出四类诊断量。1）score spread compression：比较 judge 与 human 的打分方差，若 σJ/σH 明显小于 1，说明 judge 把主观差异压扁了。2）effective rank：看评分矩阵需要多少主成分才能解释 95% 方差，若 judge 的有效秩显著低于 human，说明其评价维度更少。3）principal angle to human subspace：直接测 judge 子空间与 human 子空间的主夹角，并与 inter-human 的夹角下界比较。4）stacked correlations / null-space fraction：看 LLM-LLM 相关是否系统高于 LLM-human，以及人类评分变化中有多少落在 judge 的“盲区”。\n\n方法设计上还有两个细节很关键。其一，作者不是只测原始 judge，还系统比较了 in-context demonstration、SFT、DPO、以及 post-hoc demonstration-anchored calibration 四种干预，想回答“训练能不能把 judge 拉回人类子空间”。其二，数据选在 Indic 多语言、社区健康、文化问答这类真实主观场景，而不是英语单一、事实核验型 benchmark，这让几何诊断更接近真实部署难点。","experiments":"实验覆盖 4 个社区构建的 Indic 数据集、8 种 Indic 语言、41 个 LLM judges。数据里既有文化问答，也有社区健康场景；每个样本有 3 位独立人类评审，rubric 横跨 objective 到 subjective。模型侧包含 14 个基础 judge，以及 27 个经过训练、偏好优化或校准的变体，来自 3 个模型家族，规模从 3B 到 405B。统计上使用 paired item bootstrap 给出区间，而不是只报点估计。\n\n主结果很清楚。对于主观 rubric，LLM judge 的 score spread 只有人类的一部分，σJ/σH 约在 0.3–0.5，说明打分动态范围被明显压缩。几何上，judge 子空间与 human 子空间几乎正交，主夹角约 87–89°，而人类之间的夹角约 78–81°；也就是说，judge 离 human 比 human 彼此之间更远。相关性上，LLM-LLM Pearson 大约 0.35，而 LLM-human 约 0.1 左右甚至更低，形成“彼此一致但不贴近人类”的典型模式。只有在带可验证事实答案的 objective rubric 上，这个 gap 才明显收敛，说明问题不是 LLM 完全不会评，而是对高内在维度的主观评价会发生秩塌缩。\n\n干预实验也很有信息量。SFT 和 DPO 往往能恢复一部分 score spread，让 judge 不再那么“缩分”，但 principal angle 改善很有限，说明训练可能让分数更分散，却没有真正学到人类评价维度；有些 rubric 上甚至会退化。相对而言，post-hoc 的 demonstration-anchored calibration 是唯一一个在 community-health 四个 rubric 上都带来一致提升的方案，但仍达不到人类可靠性水平。作者还给出 boundary condition：当 judge 的可表达维度 kJ 小于某个 rubric 下人类评分流形的内在维度 dR 时，就会出现 pretraining。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"GNMR addresses runtime stability control for low-precision LLM training. Existing FP8, FP4, activation-quantization, and compressed-state recipes often treat precision as a mostly static configuration or an offline calibration choice. In practice, instability is local and transient: a specific attention or FFN operator may become risky for a few steps while the rest of the model remains safe. The question is how to decide online which local units should temporarily fall back to a higher-fidelity path under a fixed overhead budget.","importance":"The paper is directly relevant to pretraining systems and training dynamics. The hard part of low-precision training is not only average quantization error; it is whether rare local perturbations trigger loss spikes, gradient anomalies, or lasting quality degradation. GNMR reframes low-precision stability as closed-loop control: monitor local risk at every step, recover only a sparse subset of risky operators, and enforce an explicit budget. It does not rely on proposing a new numeric format or kernel. That separation is useful for real training stacks, where FP8, BF16, activation compression, optimizer-state compression, and backend-specific kernels are often mixed.","technical_approach":"The main signal is the Gradient Norm-to-Mean Ratio. For each eligible low-precision unit, such as attention or FFN projection operators, GNMR compares the current gradient norm with the unit’s historical mean. This gives a dimensionless local risk score that can be compared across modules. To detect abrupt short-term changes, the paper adds Δ-GNMR, which normalizes the signal by a recent window and emphasizes deviations from near-term behavior. The controller then ranks eligible units by risk, recovers only the top-risk subset, limits instantaneous overhead with maxO, and uses a short Tlock interval to prevent rapid switching. Selected units are routed through a higher-fidelity recovery path, while the rest continue on the low-cost path. The analysis gives a one-step expected-descent argument: when low-precision perturbations are large on critical updates, selective recovery reduces the error injected into the descent direction without paying the cost of global high-precision execution.","experiments":"The evaluation is organized around three settings. A controlled activation-quantization stress bench isolates trigger quality and local risk identification from backend effects. A Transformer Engine-backed low-precision training setup tests integration with a realistic training recipe. A large-model post-training task checks whether the controller preserves quality and keeps overhead bounded in a larger adaptation setting. The stated evaluation axes are trigger quality, budget behavior, quality preservation, and engineering overhead. The provided content does not include model sizes, token counts, loss values, recovery ratios, throughput changes, or downstream metric numbers. The key experimental questions to verify in the tables are whether GNMR gives earlier and more local warnings than global gradient norm or post-hoc loss-spike detection, how maxO and Tlock trade stability for throughput, and whether the TE-backed setting shows quality preservation with small overhead.","reading_guide":"Read carefully. In the theory part, focus on how the expected-descent analysis models low-precision perturbation and selective recovery. In the experiments, prioritize the stress bench trigger analysis, the TE-backed training results, and the large-model post-training transfer test. The most important open point is how thresholds and recovery budgets scale with model size, batch size, learning-rate phase, and the location of loss spikes; that determines whether the method can 标签监督模型，导致最后层隐藏状态的几何结构约束很弱。只要目标 token 的 logit 足够高，隐藏表示在大量与目标方向正交的子空间里如何分布，损失几乎不敏感。作者把这类自由度称为训练目标的结构性盲区，并进一步指出，这种弱约束会让表示在训练中逐步滑向低秩、各向异性的退化形态。论文的核心问题因此可以表述为：如何在不放弃 NTP 主目标、也不引入外部教师模型的前提下，为 next-token pretraining 增加对隐藏表示几何的直接监督，让模型不仅“猜对 token”，也学到更稳定、更有表达力的内部表征。","importance":"这项工作的价值主要在两个层面。第一，它把很多人对表示退化、embedding anisotropy 的观察，明确地接到了 LLM 预训练目标设计上：问题不只是表征分析里的现象，而可能是 NTP 目标本身的欠约束带来的。这个判断如果成立，影响的是 pretrain objective 的基本设计，而不只是某个训练技巧。第二，它提出的改法很克制：不改 Transformer 主体，不引入额外编码器，不做复杂蒸馏，而是在同一模型内部用浅层表示构造“隐式 token”目标，对最后层状态加一个连续空间的预测约束。这使它更像一种可插拔的 objective regularization，而不是重做一套训练范式。对预训练研究的具体启发有三点：一是 token-level likelihood 之外，representation geometry 可能需要被显式纳入训练目标；二是浅层与深层表示分工可以被利用为自监督信号，而不只是做 probing；三是未来很多关于 any-order LM、masked LM、diffusion LM 的比较，不应只看 perplexity 或下游分数，也要看训练目标如何塑造内部几何。","technical_approach":"方法本身并不复杂，但设计点比较讲究。标准自回归模型在位置 t 产生最后层隐藏状态 h_t，用它预测 x_{t+1}。NITP 在这个基础上增加一个辅助目标：让 h_t 去预测“下一个 token 的隐式表示”。这个隐式表示不是词表 embedding，也不是外部模型编码，而是同一模型在处理位置 t+1 时某个浅层层数的隐藏状态 z_{t+1}^{(l)}，并且对该目标 stop-gradient，避免目标分支与预测分支相互追逐导致塌缩。训练时联合优化 NTP 的交叉熵和一个表示相似性损失，文中采用 cosine similarity 形式，使 h_t 在语义方向上靠近这个浅层目标。\n\n这里有几个关键选择。第一，为什么用浅层表示，而不是最后层表示做 bootstrap target。作者的论证是，浅层更保留词汇和局部语义信息，尚未被深层任务特化所压缩；如果直接用深层表示当目标，容易把已经退化或过度任务化的表征再复制一遍，监督增益有限。第二，为什么预测的是 t+1 位置的表示，而不是当前 token 的重构。因为目标仍然要与 next-token 预测对齐，保持自回归训练的时间因果结构。第三，为什么用连续目标而不是离散 label smoothing 一类办法。作者认为 one-hot 或其轻微平滑版本仍主要作用在输出空间，不能直接约束隐藏状态的几何。NITP 则把监督信号直接落在 representation space。\n\n论文还给了一个理论化解释：在 NTP 下，梯度主要由目标 token 及少数高概率竞争项主导，因此 h_t 的更新主要沿着目标 embedding 相关方向发生，而在大规模正交子空间中损失近似不变。这会形成一个平坦但欠约束的优化景观，允许大量几何上很差的表示与相同 token likelihood 共存。NITP 通过增加一个稠密的向量级约束，缩小了这部分自由度，相当于给隐藏状态增加了额外的几何锚点。实现上它几乎不需要额外前向，因为浅层表示本来就在同一次 forward 中产生，额外成本主要是一个相似度损失和少量投影/对齐计算，因此作者把它定位为低开销的 objective augmentation。","experiments":"从给出的全文内容看，实验主线很清楚，重点不是刷很多 benchmark，而是验证“几何退化是否存在、NITP 是否真的缓解、缓解后是否转化为能力收益”。第一类实验是训练动态分析。作者持续跟踪最后层隐藏状态的 Effective Rank 和 batch 内 token 表示平均余弦相似度。标准 NTP 训练中，有效秩明显下降、平均余弦相似度上升，说明表示逐步挤进更窄的子空间；NITP 则能维持更高的有效秩，并抑制相似度过快升高。这是全文最关键的证据，因为它直接支撑方法提出的动机。\n\n第二类实验是下游或泛化性能。摘要里给出的结论是“consistent enhancement on downstream performance”，正文也强调提升是稳定的，而不是只在个别任务上有效。由于当前提供的全文片段没有完整表格，无法可靠抄出具体 benchmark 名称、参数规模、训练 token 数和精确提升幅度；但从写法看，作者应当做了不同模型规模或不同训练设置下的对比，并把几何改善与性能改善联系起来，而不是只报单点结果。\n\n第三类实验应包括方法消融。根据方法设计，值得关注的消融通常有：隐式目标取自哪一层浅层表示；NITP 损失权重如何设置；是否必须 stop-gradient；用 cosine loss 与其他距离损失的差异；以及如果把目标换成 embedding 或深层表示，效果是否变差。引言中已经明确声称浅层表示比深层更保留 lexical/local semantic content，因此层选择消融大概率是论文的重要部分。若阅读原文表格，建议重点确认：最佳目标层是否稳定、性能对损失权重是否敏感、几何指标改善是否先于下游收益出现。\n\n第四类证据是开销分析。作者多次强调 NITP 额外计算很小，原因是目标来自同一次前向中的浅层状态，而非额外教师网络。若正文有训练吞吐、显存或 FLOPs 对比，这部分很值得看，因为 objective-level 改进常常败在工程成本上；NITP 若真能以很低代价换来稳定收益，实用性会明显高于复杂辅助任务。","reading_guide":"建议先看 Introduction 里关于 NTP 欠约束的论证，再看 Figure 设计，而不只是预测浅层状态。","authors_note":""},"summary_en":{"core_problem":"The paper targets a specific weakness of standard autoregressive pre-training rather than challenging next-token prediction as a whole. In vanilla NTP, supervision is delivered almost entirely through a discrete one-hot label in logit space. As long as the model assigns high probability to the correct next token, the loss places only weak constraints on how the final hidden state is organized in the large subspace orthogonal to the target direction. The authors argue that this structural under-constraint lets hidden representations drift toward degenerate geometry: lower effective dimensionality, higher anisotropy, and reduced expressiveness. The core problem is therefore how to add direct representation-level supervision to AR pre-training, without abandoning NTP and without relying on external teachers, so that the model learns not only the correct token identity but also a healthier latent Linear attention, GLA, Mamba-2/SSD, DeltaNet, and related layers are usually defined as update equations. Those equations are useful for implementation, but they do not make explicit what the state represents, when an observation is redundant, or how strongly new evidence should overwrite old memory. The paper introduces a design-model framework: an auxiliary probabilistic model whose exact Bayesian filter defines the write rule of a sequence layer. The model is not meant to generate the input sequence. It is a design object for specifying how memory should accumulate evidence.","importance":"The main relevance for pretraining is architectural. This work gives a probabilistic account of such memory updates. It separates stored associations from uncertainty over those associations, and it shows that several known sub-quadratic recurrences can be viewed as exact filters or as reductions that discard covariance.
